content.original: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. The standard production model uses three Magna Medium Lasers mounted on the head and arms. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.content: В 2680 году Звездная Лига запросила у разработчиков создать «мехи, которые могут и летать, и функционировать как стандартные». Первый аэромех с чертежной доски, Shadow Hawk LAM, оказался настолько несовершенным, что концепция была почти отвергнута. Тем не менее, LexaTech Industries переработала механизм трансформации и представила первый жизнеспособный LAM, Stinger LAM, в 2688 году, основанный на старом дизайне Stinger. Переделка концепции LexaTech оказалась настолько успешной, что аэромех стал очень востребованным, особенно для космических боевых действий. Фактически, Stinger LAM в своём первом бою уничтожил завод по производству ядерного оружия в облаке Оорта, вращающемся вокруг Солнца, звезды Терры. Особенность: Мех «земля-воздух» Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.99

A single ER PPC is located in each arm, with a Large Pulse Laser installed in the center torso, and all six of the medium lasers are upgraded to medium pulse lasers. content.original: The Soarece was an experimental superheavy combat vehicle produced for the Free Worlds League in the early decades of the Third Succession War. The design was commissioned by then-Captain-General Philippa Marik in 2881. It was envisioned as a low-cost, highly survivable design that could engage BattleMechs and equip the League's depleted defensive formations . It would be over two decades (2904) until the final form of this design was settled, by which time it had become a mammoth of a tank. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. content.original: Debuted in 3144 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Marie Costa, the most striking piece of technology this machine features is a Void Signature System followed by the Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous Armor that replaced its original Capellan-style Starshield Stealth Armor and its eleven Double Heat Sinks. In the weapons section, a single MML-9 launcher appears where once there were twin MML-3s, while the mech losses the Light PPCs in favor of more ER Medium Lasers (now three). Missing is Beagle active probe while an Improved Narc Missile Beacon Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: This variant is apparently an attempt by the Jade Falcons to use experimental technology in a combat unit. Originally mistaken for a LAM, the Cougar-XR uses a Partial Wing to extend its jump range to 210 meters. An LRM-15 launcher equipped with Artemis V FCS is located in each side torso, while an ER Medium Pulse Laser provides direct fire. It appears that the Cougar-XR is a standard BattleMech instead of being an OmniMech like its progenitor design. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

This custom Solaris variant debuted in 3128 in Noisiel and piloted first by Natalia Porter and then by her daughter Carolyn Fischer, this Clint IIC upgrade reverses the trend of Clan-modified-Inner-Sphere machines. Starting from the Clan-built frame, the variant drops the Jump Jets to change the weapon load. It keeps the two Clan Extended Range Medium Laser and swaps the Clan LB 10-X AC for a Large Variable Speed Pulse Laser and a Medium Re-Engineered Laser mating them all to a Clan Targeting Computer. The standard plate armor is replaced with Ballistic-Reinforced Armor. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.content:
Это спец вариант для Соляриса, дебютировавший в 3128 году в Noisiel и пилотируемый сначала Натальей Портер, а затем её дочерью Кэролин Фишер. Это улучшение Clint IIC задало тренд на «модификацию клановыми технологиями машин Внутренней Сферы». Начиная с кланового каркаса, этот вариант отказывается от прыжковых двигателей ради вооружения. Мех сохраняет два клановых средних ER-лазера, но заменяет клановый LB 10-X AC на большой импульсный лазер переменной скорости и на средний модернизированный лазер, соединённые с клановым компьютером наведения. Стандартная пластинчатая броня заменена на усиленную баллистическую. Особенность: Разнодальнее наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.06

Лимит приводов рук: Right Lower

content.original: Developed under the guidance of Angelique Claw for Zellbrigen Stables, the Wraith Alexander combines Experimental Technology from the Clans and Inner Sphere to create a unique 'Mech. The use of a Clan-made XL Engine keeps the speed high, and allows for the installation of more equipment. The jump jets, Endo Steel structure, and Snub-Nose PPC are of Inner Sphere manufacture, but the two ER Medium Lasers, Ferro-Fibrous Armor, and twin Partial Wings were built by the Clans. The partial wings increase the Wraith's jump range to 270 meters. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13

content.original: The Soarece was an experimental superheavy combat vehicle produced for the Free Worlds League in the early decades of the Third Succession War. The design was commissioned by then-Captain-General Philippa Marik in 2881. It was envisioned as a low-cost, highly survivable design that could engage BattleMechs and equip the League's depleted defensive formations . It would be over two decades (2904) until the final form of this design was settled, by which time it had become a mammoth of a tank. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Limited Amphibious Values A S Front 770 126 Left 660 126 Right 660 126 Rear 350 126 Turret 760 126 Total 3200 630 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics

content.original: Debuted in 3144 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Marie Costa, the most striking piece of technology this machine features is a Void Signature System followed by the Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous Armor that replaced its original Capellan-style Starshield Stealth Armor and its eleven Double Heat Sinks. In the weapons section, a single MML-9 launcher appears where once there were twin MML-3s, while the mech losses the Light PPCs in favor of more ER Medium Lasers (now three). Missing is Beagle active probe while an Improved Narc Missile Beacon Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: This variant is apparently an attempt by the Jade Falcons to use experimental technology in a combat unit. Originally mistaken for a LAM, the Cougar-XR uses a Partial Wing to extend its jump range to 210 meters. An LRM-15 launcher equipped with Artemis V FCS is located in each side torso, while an ER Medium Pulse Laser provides direct fire. It appears that the Cougar-XR is a standard BattleMech instead of being an OmniMech like its progenitor design. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: The Gundam is a testament to cutting-edge technology and raw power. With advanced weapons and mobility systems, this machine is built for domination on the battlefield. Its heavily armored exterior provides unrivaled protection from enemy attacks, making it a formidable opponent for any force that stands in its way. The Gundam is a technological marvel, and the pilots who use it should be ready for a high-powered and efficient machine. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: «Гандам» — воплощение передовых технологий и неукротимой мощи. Благодаря передовому вооружению и двигательным системам эта машина создана для доминирования на поле боя. Тяжёлая броня обеспечивает непревзойдённую защиту от вражеских атак, делая мех грозным противником для любой силы, которая встанет у него на пути. «Гандам» — настоящее технологическое чудо, и пилоты, которые им управляют, должны быть готовы к мощной и эффективной машине. Особенность: Мех «земля-воздух» Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original:
This custom Solaris variant debuted in 3128 in Noisiel and piloted first by Natalia Porter and then by her daughter Carolyn Fischer, this Clint IIC upgrade reverses the trend of Clan-modified-Inner-Sphere machines. Starting from the Clan-built frame, the variant drops the Jump Jets to change the weapon load. It keeps the two Clan Extended Range Medium Laser and swaps the Clan LB 10-X AC for a Large Variable Speed Pulse Laser and a Medium Re-Engineered Laser mating them all to a Clan Targeting Computer. The standard plate armor is replaced with Ballistic-Reinforced Armor. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.content:
Это спец вариант для Соляриса, дебютировавший в 3128 году в Noisiel и пилотируемый сначала Натальей Портер, а затем её дочерью Кэролин Фишер. Это улучшение Clint IIC задало тренд на «модификацию клановыми технологиями машин Внутренней Сферы». Начиная с кланового каркаса, этот вариант отказывается от прыжковых двигателей ради вооружения. Мех сохраняет два клановых средних ER-лазера, но заменяет клановый LB 10-X AC на большой импульсный лазер переменной скорости и на средний модернизированный лазер, соединённые с клановым компьютером наведения. Стандартная пластинчатая броня заменена на усиленную баллистическую. Особенность: Разнодальнее наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.06

Лимит приводов рук: Right Lower

The most well known of these is the Matar, commonly referred to as Amaris' Folly, an attempt to create a BattleMech able to withstand an entire company. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

The use of a Clan-made XL Engine keeps the speed high, and allows for the installation of more equipment. The jump jets, Endo Steel structure, and Snub-Nose PPC are of Inner Sphere manufacture, but the two ER Medium Lasers, Ferro-Fibrous Armor, and twin Partial Wings were built by the Clans. The partial wings increase the Wraith's jump range to 270 meters. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13

content.original: The Centurion OmniMech was born out of a desire on the part of Corean Enterprises to expand the company's market share. Manufactured primarily at the Corean Enterprises' site on New Avalon and weighing in at 50 tons, the Centurion mounted a Magna 250 XL engine, allowing it to run at 86 km/h, and mounts nine and a half tons of standard armor. With ten fixed double heat sinks, the Centurion has 24 tons of pod space available, almost half the total weight of the 'Mech, and the most common variants of the Centurion echo the various variants of the original Centurion BattleMech developed over the centuries. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The first BattleMech to utilize the advanced Void Signature System, while reports of 'invisible 'Mechs' had long been ignored as confusion for such Star League era stealth systems as the Null Signature System and Chameleon Light Polarization Shield, allowed the 'Stealth Raptor' to be used with deadly effect.
content.prevOriginal: The first BattleMech to utilize the advanced Void Signature System, while reports of 'invisible 'Mechs' had long been ignored as confusion for such Star League era stealth systems as the Null Signature System and Chameleon Light Polarization Shield, allowed the 'Stealth Raptor' to be used with deadly effect.
content.content: Первый боевой мех, использовавший продвинутую систему Void Signature System. В то время как сообщения о «невидимых мехах» долгое время игнорировались, считая, что за этим кроются такие стелс-системы эпохи Звездной Лиги, как система нулевой сигнатуры и поляризационный щит «Хамелеон», это позволило «Стелс-Раптору» действовать со смертельной эффективностью.

content.original: The Centurion OmniMech was born out of a desire on the part of Corean Enterprises to expand the company's market share. Manufactured primarily at the Corean Enterprises' site on New Avalon and weighing in at 50 tons, the Centurion mounted a Magna 250 XL engine, allowing it to run at 86 km/h, and mounts nine and a half tons of standard armor. With ten fixed double heat sinks, the Centurion has 24 tons of pod space available, almost half the total weight of the 'Mech, and the most common variants of the Centurion echo the various variants of the original Centurion BattleMech developed over the centuries. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: Омнимех Centurion появился на свет благодаря стремлению Corean Enterprises расширить свою долю на рынке. content.original: The Algea A Varient Quadvee, designed by Clan Hells Horse, is a force to be reckoned with. Equipped with 60 LRM tubes and a trio of ER medium lasers, this 100-ton assault mech is a versatile and deadly addition to any battlefield. With its impressive long-range capabilities and quick maneuverability, the Algea can rain down a barrage of missiles on enemies from afar or close in for devastating laser strikes. Its armor plating is reinforced with the latest materials and its engines are top of the line, ensuring both speed and protection. The Algea is a true feat of engineering and a testament to the ingenuity of its creator. Quirk: QuadVee Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

content.original: With great effort, RISC Engineers upgraded the Catapult II chassis to an Omnimech level of technology. Employing the most advanced equipment at their disposal, this venerable design's weight was reduced to 55 tons without sacrificing any firepower. The -R1 is a skirmisher configuration, carrying thirty MML tubes and paired light PPCs for combat at any range. Advanced electronics and a jump range of 165m ensure that it can engage any target successfully. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: На основе восстановленных клановых Crossbow, а также древних записей экспериментов СОЗЛ, инженерам RISC и Skobel удалось создать более современный Crossbow. Используя экспериментальный сверхлегкий гироскоп и легкий двигатель на шасси из эндостали, они смогли повысить его мобильность и огневую мощь. content.original: Designed and produced in limited numbers by Luthien Armor Works, the DRX Dragon II Omni was an ambitious precursor to what would later become the DRG-11K. The C loadout is a through-and-through brawler. The primary weapon is officially the center-mounted ATM-12, but it's the Rotary Autocannon sourced from Skobel MechWorks that really draws attention. An 'Iron Dome' Anti-Missile System and single pulse laser round out the 'Mech. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: Разработанный и произведенный в ограниченном количестве компанией Luthien Armor Works, DRX Dragon II омнис был амбициозным предшественником того, что впоследствии стало DRG-11K. Комплектация C — настоящий боец. Официально основным оружием является ATM-12 в центре, но больше всего внимания привлекает роторная автопушка от Skobel MechWorks. content.content: Называемый jmy-wt, или «Имиут», мех представляет собой более тяжелую омнимех-модернизацию развед меха «Анубис». content.content: Assassin II — это результат запроса Федеративных Солнц на создание «быстрого ударного юнита». Корпорация Maltex предложила серьёзную переработку своего старого шасси Assassin. Получившийся боевой мех превзошёл все ожидания и начал использоваться в качестве ответа стелс-технологиям, применяемым Конфедерацией Капеллы. Особенность: Встроенный TSM Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.02 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: Ferret 'Catsnake'
content.prevOriginal: Ferret 'Catsnake'
content.content: Ferret 'Catsnake'

content.original: The Ferret 'Catsnake' is armed with a Snubnosed PPC, 8 Blackwell Machine Guns, AP and HE ammo, and FCS Machine Gun. The Ferret is an advanced 45 ton attack Hovertank, with 10/15 move. It has no turret, its weapons are Front mounted. Standard equipment on all models includes: 7.75 tons of Reactive Armor, Recon Sensors, CASE, Laser AMS, Guardian ECM + IFF Jammer Mk1, Beagle Probe, Advanced Optics Mk1 and the unique quirk 'Slippery Customer'. Owning this item allows you to select an alternate hovertank when using the Cargo Vroom's unit deploy ability. Hold Shift while placing the unit after activating the deploy ability to select a unit from among those available.

content.original: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. The standard production model uses three Magna Medium Lasers mounted on the head and arms. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

Первый аэромех с чертежной доски, Shadow Hawk LAM, оказался настолько несовершенным, что концепция была почти отвергнута. Тем не менее, LexaTech Industries переработала механизм трансформации и представила первый жизнеспособный LAM, Stinger LAM, в 2688 году, основанный на старом дизайне Stinger. Переделка концепции LexaTech оказалась настолько успешной, что аэромех стал очень востребованным, особенно для космических боевых действий. Фактически, Stinger LAM в своём первом бою уничтожил завод по производству ядерного оружия в облаке Оорта, вращающемся вокруг Солнца, звезды Терры. Особенность: Мех «земля-воздух» Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.99

content.original: This custom Solaris variant debuted in 3128 in Noisiel and piloted first by Natalia Porter and then by her daughter Carolyn Fischer, this Clint IIC upgrade reverses the trend of Clan-modified-Inner-Sphere machines. Starting from the Clan-built frame, the variant drops the Jump Jets to change the weapon load. It keeps the two Clan Extended Range Medium Laser and swaps the Clan LB 10-X AC for a Large Variable Speed Pulse Laser and a Medium Re-Engineered Laser mating them all to a Clan Targeting Computer. The standard plate armor is replaced with Ballistic-Reinforced Armor. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

Это улучшение Clint IIC задало тренд на «модификацию клановыми технологиями машин Внутренней Сферы». Начиная с кланового каркаса, этот вариант отказывается от прыжковых двигателей ради вооружения. Мех сохраняет два клановых средних ER-лазера, но заменяет клановый LB 10-X AC на большой импульсный лазер переменной скорости и на средний модернизированный лазер, соединённые с клановым компьютером наведения. Стандартная пластинчатая броня заменена на усиленную баллистическую. Особенность: Разнодальнее наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.06 Лимит приводов рук: Right Lower

Starting from the Clan-built frame, the variant drops the Jump Jets to change the weapon load. As such it was a moderate success. But critics were quick to point out that perhaps the duties of a line tank could be done more efficiently by conventional MBT, and a superheavy chassis might have been better used to mount an exceptional weapon system like a railgun. Three years later with the CTD-151 the critics got their wish.Fusion: Expensive engine that works in a Vacuum. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. content.original: The Gulltoppr OmniMonitor is a thirty-second century superheavy OmniVehicle. It was first produced for the Lyran Commonwealth and Clan Wolf-in-Exile as a defensive garrison unit. The Gulltoppr was designed and manufactured by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal in 3102, the unit was mass produced to help fill up worlds on the Clan border. Gulltoppr are mammoth machines that are noted for their impressive firepower and armor, but their slow speeds keeps them from being anything more than a defensive combat unit. Weaponry for the Gulltoppr's Primary Configuration is mounted exclusively in its two turrets. Turret one is the home to a pair of Gauss Rifles, which are fed by four tons of ammunition. Turret Two houses the vehicle's big, short-ranged Long Tom cannon and a pair of anti-missile systems. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. content.original: The Teppō artillery support vehicle is an experimental super heavy combat Vehicle which is designed to provide support to frontline combat units of the Draconis Combine. First produced just after the Jihad, this massive vehicle was designed to be a regiment's mobile artillery battery and also provide additional command and repair abilities through its pair of Support Trailers. The Teppō's creation was as a result of the hard lessons learned from nearly two decades of fighting the Word of Blake and the Black Dragon Society. Using the Ryuken's Combined-Arms command style as a model, the Teppō and its support trailers would attempt to replicate the elite brigade's command capabilities for other frontline Regiments. Built on Unity at Pesht Motors, the Teppō is noted for its high quality due to each vehicle being hand-built. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Even with the railguns taking up almost two thirds of the available internal space and weight capacity in the giant QuadMech, two ER PPC and an ER Large laser are mounted in the center torso to provide even more firepower. Using 33.5 tons of the latest Titano-Carbide Lamellor armor still allows more than enough armor to survive even the strongest attacks with just minor damages. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.45

content.original: The lack of a Clan-made Superheavy QuadMech irked some of the more progressive scientists from the clans that had made it back to the Inner Sphere. So they decided to collaborate in secret on Project Colossus, meant to be the pinnacle of Clan design and ingenuity. The resulting 200 ton Quad OmniMech was eventually renamed to the Arachnid, and was more an ode to the decadence and delusion of grandeur that has started to seep into the Inner Sphere clans than fulfilling any practical role.

content.original: The only superheavy chassis Clan Widowmaker managed to design on their own, the Atrax is a 175 ton beast in the shape of a four-legged spider. Bringing all the strengths of a QuadMech and a Superheavy together, but at the cost of very limited mobility, the 'Mech was never favoured amongst the warriors of the Widowmaker touman, who only begrudgingly piloted the Superheavy. The strangest trait of the chassis are the four LRM-10 launchers that are constructed as a permanent part of the chassis, one in each knee.

content.content: Единственное сверхтяжёлое шасси, которое клану Вдоводела удалось спроектировать самостоятельно, «Атракс» — это 175-тонный зверь в виде четвероногого паука. Сочетая в себе все преимущества квадмеха и сверхтяжа, но ценой очень ограниченной мобильности, этот мех никогда не пользовался популярностью у воинов тумена Вдоводелов, которые пилотировали этого сверхтяжа с большой неохотой. Самая странная особенность шасси — четыре пусковые установки LRM-10, встроенные в шасси, по одной в каждом колене.

content.original: The Atrax 2 replaces one of the railguns and the center torso mounted Gauss rifle with three Rotary AC/5. Although the RACs don't have the same raw burst potential as the removed Railgun, they instead allowed adapting the amount of firepower used for a more efficient application of damage. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.5

Although nowhere near a railgun in firepower, they are considerable cheaper to use, making the Atrax 3 better for situations where the extreme damage potential of the railguns is not needed. A single head mounted ER Large Laser serves as the only non-ammunition based backup weaponry. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.5

I have no idea why they though that would, but carrying around so much fuel and transformation mechanisms just makes for a very crappy LAM. Oh crap... NO! We're not going to make one of these from Urbie LAMs, it wouldn't even work like that! Just be happy it's the massive Urbie of your dreams and will freak out most green troops. Heck, it even has some fancy Clan armor and weaponry!

Tasked with being a heavy vanguard unit, mainly in defensive positions, the 200 ton QuadMech can be a formidable foe if you get too close to it. but in itself, its design is nothing revolutionary.

content.original: When the news of Precentor Vapula's Celestial series of 'Mechs reached Precentor Destral VII, he refused to have his devotion be outdone. Throwing all available, and unavailable, resources at the task, Precentor Destral VII's design team created the Leliorium, a 200t Omnimech, named after the highest rank of demons in the Ars Goetia, as compared to the Celestial series' angels. Furthering the point that these are not just the Celestials on steroids, each configuration is further named after one of the nine demon kings.  Each one brings to bear the cutting edge of experimental weaponry and armor, such as the Exsecratio Stealth Armor and the Seraphim Electronic Warfare Suite. The final check, before each unit is released from the factory, is a holy blessing by 6 high Blakist Priests, ensuring that the pilot, and 'Mech, are well taken care of by Blake.

content.content: Когда новости о мехах серии Celestial регента Вапулы достигли регента Дестрала VII, он не позволил, чтобы его преданность была превзойдена. Бросив все доступные и недоступные ресурсы на эту задачу, команда инженеров регента Дестрала VII создала «Лелиориум», 200-тонного омнимеха, названного в честь высшего ранга демонов в Ars Goetia, словно в противопоставление ангелам серии Celestial. Подчеркивая, что это не просто Celestial на стероидах, каждая конфигурация дополнительно названа в честь одного из девяти королей демонов. Каждая из них использует передовые экспериментальные вооружение и броню, такие как стелс-броня Exsecratio и комплект РЭБ Seraphim. На финальных этапах сборки, перед тем как каждый мех покинет завод, их благословляли шесть высших жрецов-блейкистов, вселяя уверенность, что за пилотом и мехом будет присматривать дух самого Блейка.

content.original: The third configuration of the Leliourium, the 'Beleth', has one role alone; to deliver the vengeance of the Manei Domini as direct as possible. To achieve this goal a new weapon was created, the Astral Hammer, said to be created by Blake himself. Mounting a total of four of these immense autocannons, and nothing else but a single SRM-6 launcher, means the 'Mech has to get quite close before being able to strike - but once there even the most brave of foes will think twice about staying close. Quirk: Wrath of Blake Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.39 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Throwing all available, and unavailable, resources at the task, Precentor Destral VII's design team created the Leliorium, a 200t Omnimech, named after the highest rank of demons in the Ars Goetia, as compared to the Celestial series' angels. Furthering the point that these are not just the Celestials on steroids, each configuration is further named after one of the nine demon kings.  Each one brings to bear the cutting edge of experimental weaponry and armor, such as the Exsecratio Stealth Armor and the Seraphim Electronic Warfare Suite. The final check, before each unit is released from the factory, is a holy blessing by 6 high Blakist Priests, ensuring that the pilot, and 'Mech, are well taken care of by Blake.

content.content: Когда новости о мехах серии Celestial регента Вапулы достигли регента Дестрала VII, он не позволил, чтобы его преданность была превзойдена. Бросив все доступные и недоступные ресурсы на эту задачу, команда инженеров регента Дестрала VII создала «Лелиориум», 200-тонного омнимеха, названного в честь высшего ранга демонов в Ars Goetia, словно в противопоставление ангелам серии Celestial. Подчеркивая, что это не просто Celestial на стероидах, каждая конфигурация дополнительно названа в честь одного из девяти королей демонов. Каждая из них использует передовые экспериментальные вооружение и броню, такие как стелс-броня Exsecratio и комплект РЭБ Seraphim. На финальных этапах сборки, перед тем как каждый мех покинет завод, их благословляли шесть высших жрецов-блейкистов, вселяя уверенность, что за пилотом и мехом будет присматривать дух самого Блейка.

content.original: The Manx is a ComStar design for an heavy impact superheavy based around Rotary Autocannons of various sizes and types. At 170 ton and using all the weight saving technology there is, an impressive amount of weapons can be fit on the chassis. The arm and shoulder actuators are strengthened to allow for reduction of the weapon recoil. Even the sensor and piloting equipment are top notch, the combination of Vehicular DNI, Angel ECM, Bloodhound Probe and a C3i unit making it near impossible to not perform well with the 'Mech on the battlefield.

content.content: Manx — это разработанный КомСтаром проект сверхтяжёлого ударного меха, оснащённого роторными автопушками различных размеров и типов. При массе 170 тонн и использовании всех доступных технологий снижения веса, на шасси можно разместить впечатляющее количество вооружения. Приводы рук и плеч усилены для уменьшения отдачи. Даже сенсорное и пилотское оборудование — высшего качества: сочетание систем Vehicular DNI, Angel ECM, Bloodhound Probe и блока C3i делает практически невозможным этому меху плохо проявить себя на поле боя.

content.original: The Manx is a ComStar design for an heavy impact superheavy based around Rotary Autocannons of various sizes and types. At 170 ton and using all the weight saving technology there is, an impressive amount of weapons can be fit on the chassis. The arm and shoulder actuators are strengthened to allow for reduction of the weapon recoil. Even the sensor and piloting equipment are top notch, the combination of Vehicular DNI, Angel ECM, Bloodhound Probe and a C3i unit making it near impossible to not perform well with the 'Mech on the battlefield.

content.original: The MAD-13F is the latest design of the Marauder III Superheavy. Using all the latest technology to free weight, it combines a 350 XXL engine core with an XXL Gyro, meaning its side torsos are very vulnerable upon taking any damage. However, thanks to these sacrifices the design is able to mount one Heavy PPC and a Large X-Pulse laser in each arm. Rounding out the design is an Improved Heavy Gauss Rifle with 4 tons of ammunition. The 'Mech does suffer from a fatal flaw in far too inconsistent cooling, a single alpha strike could shut the 'Mech down if the pilot is not careful. content.original: With the bad reputation the Sarath had obtained, the Free Worlds League approved the creation of a 140 ton superheavy version in an attempt to regain some of the design lines reputation. The task of designing it was once again given to Ronin Inc, and the result was the Narayana Omni QuadMech. Its main focus are on indirect fire support with a 425 XL engine to ensure the QuadMech is mobile enough to reposition without too much delay. Eventually a deal was struck with House Steiner to also provide them with a number of Narayana, making that the only other faction to field any of the 'Mechs.

content.content: Учитывая дурную репутацию «Сарата», Лига Свободных Миров одобрила создание 140-тонной сверхтяжёлой версии, пытаясь восстановить хотя бы часть былой репутации. Разработка была вновь поручена Ronin Inc., и результатом стал квад-омнимех «Нараяна». Его основная задача заключалась в огневой поддержке с закрытых позиций. С помощью двигателя 425 XL обеспечивалась мобильность квадмеха для быстрой смены позиций. В конечном итоге была заключена сделка с Домом Штайнер о поставке им нескольких «Нараян», что сделало эту фракцию второй из всего двух, кто выставлял на вооружение этого меха.

content.original: Fulfilling the role of "Trickster Teacher", the Nuwisha is Clan Coyote's first major foray into Superheavy 'Mechs, and speaks much to their experience in pushing the boundaries of Clan technology. Relying on the perennial favorite of ER PPCs to provide ammo-less firepower at long range, the A loadout otherwise mounts a total of four iATM-12 launchers and brings six tons of assorted ammunition, including EMP, high-explosive and Inferno. Twenty-two double heatsinks keep the heat manageable, yet they are insufficient for continuous alpha strikes. Quirk: Self Repair Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.31 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Oh man Boss, this thing is a dream to work on. Those Coyote scientists included all the design schematics, ammunition formulas, everything to make the mech, in multiple redundant data storage spots located around the mech. Relying on the perennial favorite of ER PPCs to provide ammoless firepower at long range, the primary configuration's HAG 30's in each arm seek out any opened armor, or shred any infantry that comes near. content.original: The Ophanim was created by the Word of Blake to become the keystone of their blessed military forces. Weighting in at 150t and utilizing a 425-rated core, the Ophanim brings Divine Wrath in its arms, and the Blessed Rains in the side torsos.  Those hoping that great weight given to the weaponry has cost it armor protection, will find that the Spirit of Blake has been blessed on this Sanctus Armor, helping to lift the load from those going to preach the Truth under fire.  Included as well, is a Blessed Gyro, and Seraphim EWAR Suite, both given blessings by the highest priests of the order, which has had some positive effects on combat performance. And to drive home the point that this is a model just for those who truly believe, it requires the pilot to have undergone significant cyberfication, to the point of almost embedding them into the cockpit.

content.original: Peacemaker PCM-3B is the first variant of the chassis designed by StarCorps Industries. It was mainly sold to a few of House Kurita's DCMS platoons, but after the initial trials it did not receive favorable reviews and most units ended up in mercenary hands. The -3B mounts one Heavy PPC in each arm, with a Light PPC and a SRM-6 launcher as support in each side torso. Even with such a limited weaponry and a total of 17 double heat sinks the design still struggles slightly with heat management. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.35 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: When StarCorps Industries wanted to move into the superheavy market, they created the Peacemaker. With a familiar exterior design they hoped to build on top of the Warhammer's reputation for being "just enough". However, the final product instead turned into a PPC focused 155 ton superheavy, which was not cheap nor as versatile as the Warhammer.

content.content: Когда StarCorps Industries решила выйти на рынок сверхтяжей, они создали «Миротворца». Обладая знакомым внешним видом, они надеялись превзойти репутацию Warhammer как «более менее нормального» меха. Однако конечный продукт вместо этого превратился в 155-тонный сверхтяжёлый мех, ориентированный на PPC, который был не таким дешёвым и универсальным, как Warhammer.

content.original: When StarCorps Industries wanted to move into the superheavy market, they created the Peacemaker. With a familiar exterior design they hoped to build on top of the Warhammer's reputation for being "just enough". However, the final product instead turned into a PPC focused 155 ton superheavy, which was not cheap nor as versatile as the Warhammer.

content.original: The -5M is designed to be a support force, using its Chameleon LPS to protect its whereabouts before delivering a long range strike. The combination of an Arrow IV launcher and a Thumper Artillery means the 'Mech can handle most support assignments, and two LRM-20 launchers provide more accurate firepower as needed. Two small mortars are used to deploy smoke as needed on the battlefield. The Serket 5M's major flaw is it lack of speed, it only brings a 275 engine core meaning almost any foe can easily catch it once detected. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.32

content.original: The SG11-B is one of the original designs of the Stone Giant, and as such only the Federated Suns have been seen to use it. The role of the variant tends to be as a frontline brawler, able to deal with most situations thanks to its varied weapons loadout. For long distance, high damage strikes a M9 Gauss Rifle and an Ultra AC/5 is mounted in the arms, two Enhanced LRM-10 launchers in the side torsos allow indirect fire support and a light PPC and two Large X-Pulse Lasers add extra punch when needed. A 395 XL engine and a light ferro structure are the only other points of interest of the design. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.4

content.original: The Stone Giant is a 180 ton superheavy developed by Robinson Standard BattleWorks at their main research and development plant on Robinson III, loosely based on the Atlas. It's a very versatile chassis that exists in many variants with different configurations and roles. Although initially sold to Federated Suns only it soon reached new markets all over the Inner Sphere and even some larger Periphery states.

A Magna ER PPC and an Ultra AC/2 are further mounted in the arms for direct firepower. Although its weapons are limited in amount, the stealth aspect and for a superheavy high mobility means the 'Mech can fulfill a flanker or support role. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.4

content.original: As more and more Superheavy 'Mechs started appearing with the Inner Sphere and Clan armies, a rising demand for them was created within the periphery states as well. With their limited resources and more mundane needs, Earthwerks Limited saw an opportunity to create a cheap, simple design that still could take a beating. The choice was to create the 190 ton Thunderstone, trying to use the good reputation of the Thunderbolt as a launch platform it was designed with very similar looks. The high tonnage might at first seem to go against the cheap and simple concept, but it allows Earthwerks Limited to use less optimized components, which in turn allows the customers to do their own repair and maintenance at lower costs. The design comes with a 350 rated engine core, double heat sinks and an AMS by default.

content.content: По мере того, как всё больше и больше сверхтяжёлых мехов появлялось в армиях Внутренней Сферы и Кланов, спрос на них рос и в государствах Периферии. С их ограниченными ресурсами и более приземлёнными потребностями Earthwerks Limited увидела возможность создать дешёвую, простую конструкцию, которая всё же могла бы выдерживать удары. Выбор был сделан в пользу создания 190-тонного Thunderstone, пытаясь использовать хорошую репутацию Thunderbolt в качестве стартовой платформы. Он был разработан с очень похожим внешним видом. Большой тоннаж может на первый взгляд показаться противоречащим дешёвой и простой концепции, но он позволяет Earthwerks Limited использовать менее оптимизированные компоненты, что, в свою очередь, позволяет клиентам выполнять свой собственный ремонт и обслуживание с меньшими затратами. Конструкция по умолчанию поставляется с двигателем рейтинга 350, двойными охладителями и AMS.

content.original: The Uberjager UJ9-P4 is a prototype using a specialized LWP gyro, a remanent from the Star League era found in the Helm's Deep cache. As the LWP gyro is lighter than the typical Heavy Duty gyro, while still retaining some of the positive affects of reducing the amount of instability generated by firing large weapons, the design was able to mount a Long Tom Cannon in the right arm, yet not suffer any risk of knockdowns on fire. Two RAC/5 are mounted in the opposite arm, and an Angel ECM and Active Probe provide decent EWS capabilities. The Engine was also upgraded to a 375 core and a few more tons of armor were added. All this was possible due to the prototype using clan technology rather than the standard Inner Sphere tech. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.27 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: When the Capellan Confederation needed a new 'Mech to export, House Liao decided the easiest and cheapest way was to "acquire" the design of the Sunder OmniMech from a certain neighbor Inner Sphere state. To prevent any accusations about using their design without permissions, House Liao scientists then decided to simply upscale the design and make it a superheavy. This is how the 165 ton Wannu OmniMech was born, which then was exported to both the Lyrans and the Suns. Some even found their way back to the Draconis Combine, although House Kurita did refuse to buy any directly for some reason.

content.original: The Gulltoppr OmniMonitor is a thirty-second century superheavy OmniVehicle. It was first produced for the Lyran Commonwealth and Clan Wolf-in-Exile as a defensive garrison unit. The Gulltoppr was designed and manufactured by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal in 3102, the unit was mass produced to help fill up worlds on the Clan border. Gulltoppr are mammoth machines that are noted for their impressive firepower and armor, but their slow speeds keeps them from being anything more than a defensive combat unit. Weaponry for the Gulltoppr's Primary Configuration is mounted exclusively in its two turrets. Turret one is the home to a pair of Gauss Rifles, which are fed by four tons of ammunition. Turret Two houses the vehicle's big, short-ranged Long Tom cannon and a pair of anti-missile systems. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. content.original: The Teppō artillery support vehicle is an experimental super heavy combat Vehicle which is designed to provide support to frontline combat units of the Draconis Combine. First produced just after the Jihad, this massive vehicle was designed to be a regiment's mobile artillery battery and also provide additional command and repair abilities through its pair of Support Trailers. The Teppō's creation was as a result of the hard lessons learned from nearly two decades of fighting the Word of Blake and the Black Dragon Society. Using the Ryuken's Combined-Arms command style as a model, the Teppō and its support trailers would attempt to replicate the elite brigade's command capabilities for other frontline Regiments. Built on Unity at Pesht Motors, the Teppō is noted for its high quality due to each vehicle being hand-built. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 400 105 Left 400 105 Right 400 105 Rear 400 105 Turret 400 105 Total 2000 525 Quirk: Enhanced FPE Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads.

content.original: The two massive railguns defines the Arachnid's primary configuration, both in appearance and in design. Even with the railguns taking up almost two thirds of the available internal space and weight capacity in the giant QuadMech, two ER PPC and an ER Large laser are mounted in the center torso to provide even more firepower. Using 33.5 tons of the latest Titano-Carbide Lamellor armor still allows more than enough armor to survive even the strongest attacks with just minor damages. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.45

content.original: The first variant of the Atrax is a real danger for any foe. Twin Railguns means its alpha strike is amongst the strongest of all 'Mechs, enough firepower to punch through the armor even of a spaceship. A center torso mounted Gauss rifle, combined with the fixed four LRM-10 launchers increases the raw damage potential even more. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.5

content.original: In an attempt to use up their surplus of outdated Improved Gauss Rifles, the Atrax 3 mounts six of them as its main weapons. Although nowhere near a railgun in firepower, they are considerable cheaper to use, making the Atrax 3 better for situations where the extreme damage potential of the railguns is not needed. A single head mounted ER Large Laser serves as the only non-ammunition based backup weaponry. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.5

content.original: The Atrax 5, or the Acorn Shooter as it is often derogatorily nicknamed, carries a total of eight Rotary Autocannon 2. Although their range is over the kilometer, the low accuracy of repeated shots means the actual damage dealt is often nowhere near its full potential at longer ranges. A single head mounted ER PPC works as the secondary line of fire together with the four fixed LRM-10 launchers. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.5

content.original: An artillery only version of the Black Rose, mounting both a Long Tom and a Hellstorm Artillery. Purely meant as a backline, long distance support 'Mech, the design has no other weapons except two re-engineered small lasers to help it if engaged in close combat. Utilizing a torso mounted cockpit allows the QuadMech to better designate the firing zones as it allows a 360 degree oversight. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.29

content.original: The MAD-13F is the latest design of the Marauder III Superheavy. Using all the latest technology to free weight, it combines a 350 XXL engine core with an XXL Gyro, meaning its side torsos are very vulnerable upon taking any damage. However, thanks to these sacrifices the design is able to mount one Heavy PPC and a Large X-Pulse laser in each arm. Rounding out the design is an Improved Heavy Gauss Rifle with 4 tons of ammunition. The 'Mech does suffer from a fatal flaw in far too inconsistent cooling, a single alpha strike could shut the 'Mech down if the pilot is not careful. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.26 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: So look Commander, this thing is a gigantic beast but it's really an IndustrialMech SLDF Prototype made for working on DropShips that is over 300 years old. I am not sure how _these_ fraggers have kept the thing running for 300 years, but I'm pretty sure one of the arms is like 6 legs of various UrbanMechs welded together. The ''armor'' is just the chest pieces of what has to be dozens of other mechs welded onto this freakshow. I have no idea why but the locals have been using it to build barns. For cows. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.32

Relying on the perennial favorite of ER PPCs to provide ammoless firepower at long range, the primary configuration's HAG 30's in each arm seek out any opened armor, or shred any infantry that comes near. The SRM6, loading with a ton each of Inferno and standard, speaks more to the "Teaching" effect the mech has; opening up Clan warriors to the wider variety of available ammunition. While the Coyotes lost many of the first production run in trials, the mech was highly effective in bringing not only Superheavy technology to other Clans, but also advanced weapon systems and alternative ammunition that were often suppressed by Clan leadership and warriors, who thought only traditional introductory weaponry was honorable. Quirk: Self Repair Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.31 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The -5M is designed to be a support force, using its Chameleon LPS to protect its whereabouts before delivering a long range strike. The combination of an Arrow IV launcher and a Thumper Artillery means the 'Mech can handle most support assignments, and two LRM-20 launchers provide more accurate firepower as needed. Two small mortars are used to deploy smoke as needed on the battlefield. The Serket 5M's major flaw is it lack of speed, it only brings a 275 engine core meaning almost any foe can easily catch it once detected. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.32

Just like the -5M, the model does suffer from lack of mobility and has to rely on killing any enemies before they can reach the 'Mech's position. content.original: The SG11-B is one of the original designs of the Stone Giant, and as such only the Federated Suns have been seen to use it. The role of the variant tends to be as a frontline brawler, able to deal with most situations thanks to its varied weapons loadout. For long distance, high damage strikes a M9 Gauss Rifle and an Ultra AC/5 is mounted in the arms, two Enhanced LRM-10 launchers in the side torsos allow indirect fire support and a light PPC and two Large X-Pulse Lasers add extra punch when needed. A 395 XL engine and a light ferro structure are the only other points of interest of the design. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.4

content.original: The Stone Giant SG11-D was the first variant exported outside the Federated Suns. Using state of the art Superheavy Stealth armor, a 440 XXL engine and two Enhanced LRM-20 launchers meant it was quite the upgrade over the earlier variants. A Magna ER PPC and an Ultra AC/2 are further mounted in the arms for direct firepower. This is achieved by mounting a Long Tom Artillery and two Arrow IV launchers, all with both standard and specialised ammunition to control the battlefield. Two Artemis V LRM-20 launchers can be use for direct fire if the 'Mech is directly engaged, but no other defensive weapons are provided and the 300 rated compact engine means the Superheavy is very slow to maneuver out of harms way. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.47 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Uberjager UJ9-P4 is a prototype using a specialized LWP gyro, a remanent from the Star League era found in the Helm's Deep cache. As the LWP gyro is lighter than the typical Heavy Duty gyro, while still retaining some of the positive affects of reducing the amount of instability generated by firing large weapons, the design was able to mount a Long Tom Cannon in the right arm, yet not suffer any risk of knockdowns on fire. Two RAC/5 are mounted in the opposite arm, and an Angel ECM and Active Probe provide decent EWS capabilities. The Engine was also upgraded to a 375 core and a few more tons of armor were added. All this was possible due to the prototype using clan technology rather than the standard Inner Sphere tech. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.27 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: So look Commander, this thing is a gigantic beast but it's really an IndustrialMech SLDF Prototype made for working on DropShips that is over 300 years old. I am not sure how _these_ fraggers have kept the thing running for 300 years, but I'm pretty sure one of the arms is like 6 legs of various UrbanMechs welded together. The ''armor'' is just the chest pieces of what has to be dozens of other mechs welded onto this freakshow. I have no idea why but the locals have been using it to build barns. For cows.

content.original: As more and more Superheavy 'Mechs started appearing with the Inner Sphere and Clan armies, a rising demand for them was created within the periphery states as well. With their limited resources and more mundane needs, Earthwerks Limited saw an opportunity to create a cheap, simple design that still could take a beating. The choice was to create the 190 ton Thunderstone, trying to use the good reputation of the Thunderbolt as a launch platform it was designed with very similar looks. The high tonnage might at first seem to go against the cheap and simple concept, but it allows Earthwerks Limited to use less optimized components, which in turn allows the customers to do their own repair and maintenance at lower costs. The design comes with a 350 rated engine core, double heat sinks and an AMS by default.

content.content: По мере того, как всё больше и больше сверхтяжёлых мехов появлялось в армиях Внутренней Сферы и Кланов, спрос на них рос и в государствах Периферии. С их ограниченными ресурсами и более приземлёнными потребностями Earthwerks Limited увидела возможность создать дешёвую, простую конструкцию, которая всё же могла бы выдерживать удары. Выбор был сделан в пользу создания 190-тонного Thunderstone, пытаясь использовать хорошую репутацию Thunderbolt в качестве стартовой платформы. Он был разработан с очень похожим внешним видом. Большой тоннаж может на первый взгляд показаться противоречащим дешёвой и простой концепции, но он позволяет Earthwerks Limited использовать менее оптимизированные компоненты, что, в свою очередь, позволяет клиентам выполнять свой собственный ремонт и обслуживание с меньшими затратами. Конструкция по умолчанию поставляется с двигателем рейтинга 350, двойными охладителями и AMS.

content.original: When the news of Precentor Vapula's Celestial series of 'Mechs reached Precentor Destral VII, he refused to have his devotion be outdone. Throwing all available, and unavailable, resources at the task, Precentor Destral VII's design team created the Leliorium, a 200t Omnimech, named after the highest rank of demons in the Ars Goetia, as compared to the Celestial series' angels. Furthering the point that these are not just the Celestials on steroids, each configuration is further named after one of the nine demon kings.  Each one brings to bear the cutting edge of experimental weaponry and armor, such as the Exsecratio Stealth Armor and the Seraphim Electronic Warfare Suite. The final check, before each unit is released from the factory, is a holy blessing by 6 high Blakist Priests, ensuring that the pilot, and 'Mech, are well taken care of by Blake.

content.content: Когда новости о мехах серии Celestial регента Вапулы достигли регента Дестрала VII, он не позволил, чтобы его преданность была превзойдена. Бросив все доступные и недоступные ресурсы на эту задачу, команда инженеров регента Дестрала VII создала «Лелиориум», 200-тонного омнимеха, названного в честь высшего ранга демонов в Ars Goetia, словно в противопоставление ангелам серии Celestial. Подчеркивая, что это не просто Celestial на стероидах, каждая конфигурация дополнительно названа в честь одного из девяти королей демонов. Каждая из них использует передовые экспериментальные вооружение и броню, такие как стелс-броня Exsecratio и комплект РЭБ Seraphim. На финальных этапах сборки, перед тем как каждый мех покинет завод, их благословляли шесть высших жрецов-блейкистов, вселяя уверенность, что за пилотом и мехом будет присматривать дух самого Блейка.

content.original: The second of the loadouts using weapons looted from a RISC facility, the 'Zagan' is the 8th variant in the series. With a clear offensive profile in form of an Astral Hammer and a Hyper Laser in each arm, and a MMS-40 launcher in each side torso, the loadout is able to deliver quite the punch if allowed close enough. A single head mounted Medium Pulse Laser is kept as a backup for close quarter defence, but is not recommended to see continued use due to the somewhat limited cooling of the loadout. Quirk: Wrath of Blake Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.39 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Бросив все доступные и недоступные ресурсы на эту задачу, команда инженеров регента Дестрала VII создала «Лелиориум», 200-тонного омнимеха, названного в честь высшего ранга демонов в Ars Goetia, словно в противопоставление ангелам серии Celestial. Подчеркивая, что это не просто Celestial на стероидах, каждая конфигурация дополнительно названа в честь одного из девяти королей демонов. Каждая из них использует передовые экспериментальные вооружение и броню, такие как стелс-броня Exsecratio и комплект РЭБ Seraphim. На финальных этапах сборки, перед тем как каждый мех покинет завод, их благословляли шесть высших жрецов-блейкистов, вселяя уверенность, что за пилотом и мехом будет присматривать дух самого Блейка.

content.original: The 170 ton Stalker IV superheavy 'Mech, or the SuperStalker as commonly known amongst MechWarriors, is the creation of the best minds at the Republic Institute for Strategic Combat (RISC). It is an attempt to convert the otherwise somewhat fragile Stalker to a true superheavy juggernaut, combining the experimental Superheavy Ferro-Alloy armor with a reinforced structure and a heavy duty gyro. All together this creates an extremely durable basis for the rest of the 'Mech, although limited in free space and available weight capacity.

Это попытка превратить хрупкого «Сталкера» в настоящий сверхтяжёлый джаггернаут, сочетающий экспериментальную сверхтяжёлую ферросплавную броню с усиленным каркасом и сверхмощным гироскопом. Всё вместе создает чрезвычайно прочную основу для остальных компонентов меха, хотя и ограниченную в доступном внутреннем пространстве и свободном весе.

content.original: The -R1 variant represents exactly what RISC is all about, highly experimental and focused technology while ignoring any conventional customs or practices. A 475 rated engine core using their proprietary ultralight engine technology, almost 27 tons of Micro-Alloyed Ferro-Fibrous Armor, a Radical Heat Sink Kit and a specialized Emergency Coolant System for superheavies - this 'Mech has it all. Even on the weapons department it is impressive, if for a different reason. A total of 90 Heavy MRM tubes with 5 tons of ammunition show the total commitment to the single-mindedness of the design. To be able to squeeze it all into the 'Mech heavy use of Patchwork Materials was also needed. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HMRM Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.43 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The personal design of Feng Hu, the mastermind behind the concept of the Tian Xie Zuo, the F configuration is an attempt to turn the Quad into a true vanguard unit. Ten Medium Pulse Lasers, a Light PPC and a M9 Gauss Rifle as weapons, while Hardened Ferro-Fibrous armor and a torso mounted cockpit makes the 'Mech considerably more durable than the other loadouts. The designs major survivability drawback is its XL engine, which by protruding into the side torsos opens the core up for more chances to get hit. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.36

content.original: The Victor XR was a project by the Republic Institute of Strategic Combat to supersize a Victor and use it as a platform for the newly developed Micro Missile System, their replacement for the MRM. A number of variants were developed, some even including stealth or huge ballistic weapons, but all were based around the same 445 Ultralight engine and compact Gyro. Overall the project was deemed a failure, just like the MMS itself, but enough of the 'Mechs were produced that they can still be found throughout the Inner Sphere.

content.original: The Warlock is a recent 110 ton Inner Sphere design which utilizes a combination of advanced technology originating from the infamous R.I.S.C. laboratories and Clan level tech. The 'Mech has been adopted by all the great houses to some degree, and is generally used as controlling force on the battlefield. Although not heavily armed they should never be underestimated for their alpha strike potential.

content.original: Realizing the X007 cost a lot more to produce than it is was worth on the battlefield, the RISC engineers instead came up with the X009. An Ultralight 415 fusion engine provides more maneuverability and a more standard Chameleon LPS replaces the Micro-Alloyed Ferro-Fibrous Armor. Two MML-20 launchers and two Heavy PPCs provide the main firepower of the design, with a Silverbullet Gauss and a Large X-Pulse laser available as needed. With a clear offensive profile in form of an Astral Hammer and a Hyper Laser in each arm, and a MMS-40 launcher in each side torso, the loadout is able to deliver quite the punch if allowed close enough. A single head mounted Medium Pulse Laser is kept as a backup for close quarter defence, but is not recommended to see continued use due to the somewhat limited cooling of the loadout. content.original: The -R1 variant represents exactly what RISC is all about, highly experimental and focused technology while ignoring any conventional customs or practices. A 475 rated engine core using their proprietary ultralight engine technology, almost 27 tons of Micro-Alloyed Ferro-Fibrous Armor, a Radical Heat Sink Kit and a specialized Emergency Coolant System for superheavies - this 'Mech has it all. Even on the weapons department it is impressive, if for a different reason. A total of 90 Heavy MRM tubes with 5 tons of ammunition show the total commitment to the single-mindedness of the design. To be able to squeeze it all into the 'Mech heavy use of Patchwork Materials was also needed. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HMRM Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.43 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The -R2 is even more extreme in its focus than the -R1, the variant drops most of the cutting edge experimental technology but instead manages to fit two Heavy MRM-60 launchers. Thanks to its 19 compact heat sinks the 'Mech can somewhat manage the immense heat buildup of the huge launchers, relaying on its Emergency Coolant System to not overheat in repeated volley situations. A total of 8 tons of varied ammunition types means the R2 is able to fire more salvos than the earlier R1 design. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HMRM Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.43 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: As with many other Inner Sphere Superheavy designs, the Republic Institute of Strategic Combat acquired the rights to construct their own version of the chassis to evaluate its combat potential. Mounting a total of four Superheavy Rotary Autocannon/2, instead of the more standard for the chassis twin SHRAC/5, allows the 'Mech to engage at much further distances. A side torso mounted Hyper Laser and a RISC improved MML-10 act as follow up damage, with the MML having an attached Artemis IV Fire Control System. The even further improve the performance on the 'field, the engine has been upgraded to a proprietary 400 Ultralight core, and the heat sinks to prototype versions. content.original: The King Dragon is a new addition to the roster of 'Mechs fielded by House Kurita in the Inner Sphere. Developed by the well-known manufacturer, Takara Tomy, this 'Mech was a massive upgrade over the 60-ton Dragon - both considering firepower and survivability. With its imposing size and heavily reinforced armor, the King Dragon was designed to fill the role of the ultimate heavy-hitter on the battlefield, a true Dreadnought. Despite its massive size, the King Dragon is surprisingly agile thanks to its highly balance chassis, making it a formidable opponent even for lighter and more nimble 'Mechs. This agility, combined with its advanced targeting systems and unparalleled firepower, makes the King Dragon a fearsome sight on any battlefield. The King Dragon quickly gained a reputation as one of the most fearsome and unstoppable Superheavy BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere and pilots of the 'Mech quickly became legendary figures in the various wars and conflicts that wracked the region, inspiring awe and fear in equal measure. Overall, the King Dragon is a testament to the engineering prowess of Takara Tomy and the relentless pursuit of new and improved designs to bring to the battlefield.

content.content: Мех King Dragon — новое дополнение к списку мехов, используемых Домом Курита во Внутренней Сфере. Разработанный известным производителем Takara Tomy, этот мех был серьезным улучшением по сравнению с 60-тонным Dragon — как с точки зрения огневой мощи, так и живучести. Благодаря своим внушительным размерам и мощной усиленной броне, King Dragon был разработан, чтобы выполнять роль главного тяжелого ударника на поле боя, настоящего дредноута. Несмотря на свои огромные размеры, King Dragon удивительно маневренен благодаря отлично сбалансированному шасси, что делает его грозным противником даже для более легких и проворных мехов. Эта маневренность, в сочетании с передовыми системами наведения и непревзойденной огневой мощью, делает King Dragon устрашающим зрелищем на любом поле боя. «Королевский Дракон» быстро завоевал репутацию одного из самых грозных и неудержимых сверхтяжёлых боевых мехов Внутренней Сферы, а пилоты этого меха стали легендарными фигурами в различных войнах и конфликтах, сотрясавших регион, внушая одновременно благоговение и страх. В целом, King Dragon — свидетельство инженерного мастерства Takara Tomy и неустанного стремления к созданию новых и усовершенствованных конструкций для использования на поле боя.

content.original: Well boss, the shell of this thing is still an Alacorn so you got a bunch of armor. But some junker thought the original Gauss Rifles were too heavy so they just cut the end of the barrels off, remounted them crooked in the turret and broke the optics in the process. Now what you have is a weapon that charges up a bit faster and fires a projectile in the general direction of your target.

content.original: A tank formerly owned by filthy and demented pirates is the last place you'd expect a Shakespeare reference, but here we are. Renowned for its heavy punch, the Brutus Assault Tank features an impressive combination of long and short range firepower. Powered by a Rawlings 225 Fusion Engine with a top speed of 54kph, the Brutus compares well to other fusion engine equipped tanks of similar weight and role like the Von Luckner and Manticore, though most variants are more lightly armored in exchange for a heavier weapons array. Despite its abilities, the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces remained lukewarm on the design. However it eventually found an enthusiastic user base among the Federated Suns. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: Introduced in 3054, the Cavalry Attack Helicopter was one of a number of VTOLs developed to fight the Clans by Michaelson Heavy Industries. Suited to hit-and-run engagements rather than front-line combat situations the Cavalry gained a reputation for flawless service when used correctly. It has since seen service in former FedCom States and minor-nobles among the Chaos March. While capable of speeds up to 162 km/h, the Cavalry doesn't rely on this alone for protection and has 3.5 tons armor. The craft can handle a direct hit from a Clan-tech ER PPC on the nose and keep flying. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. content.content: Введенный в эксплуатацию в 3054 году, боевой вертолет Cavalry был одним из ряда VTOL, разработанных компанией Michaelson Heavy Industries для противодействия Кланам. Подходящий скорее для тактики бей-и-беги, чем для боевых действий на передовой, Cavalry завоевал безупречную репутацию, при условии правильного использования. С тех пор он использовался в бывших государствах ФедСода и мелкими дворянами в Марше Хаоса. Substantial armor of at least six tons and various mid and long range weapon packages keep the Condor relevant. content.original: This is a pirate field refit of the old SLDF Demon PPC variant. The cannons are mismatched. It's hard to say if this was intentional or just what they had on hand. The Demon was originally created by the SLDF as its standard fighting vehicle in 2716. A match for any light or medium BattleMech, the Demon had good maneuverability and was protected by ten tons of slab armor, most of it concentrated in its front. Due to the nature of its powerful main weapon the Demon was often used in ambush attacks and fought in pairs instead of the usual four-vehicle lance. The vehicle's main disadvantage was its lack of speed, which made it vulnerable to faster 'Mechs and other vehicles able to maneuver around and engage its weaker rear armor. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: Unsurprisingly an urban fighting IFV is like Ignis is fairly popular with pirates. This one has been 'upgraded' with some custom flamers. Designed by United Mechanics, LLC on Apollo for the Rim Worlds Republic as an anti-insurgent vehicle. Originally based on an infantry personnel carrier, it was designed for urban assault against urban shelters. The vehicle was used to ram its target buildings so it could deliver its infantry squad into the breached structure. Originally named the Ram, the vehicle crews during its original time of use, came to use another name. It was referred to as the Ignis, with flamers reminding them of the Vedic god of fire. content.original: The Kamakiri mounts three weapon systems mounted in the front of the VTOL - a single Tiegart Particle Projection Cannon and a pair of Telos ThunderShot Thunderbolt 10 Missile Launchers. The Kamakiri Attack VTOL was developed at the end of the thirty-first century by Yan Manufacturing of New Samarkand as a result of their growing success in the military aerospace market. Dubbed as resembling a praying mantis, the Kamakiri was an immediate success; the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery personnel responsible for supervising the first vehicle trial watched for just two minutes before approving the Kamakiri for purchase. Moving as fast as many reconnaissance and strike platforms in service with the DCMS already thanks to the DAV 155 XL extra light engine, the original specification armor installed by Yan was replaced with seven tons of StarGuard Aurora Reflective at the request of the DCMS, who wanted to improve the Kamakari's protection against energy weapons, although the nature of the Reflective Armor didn't offer any additional protection against the flak commonly directed at VTOLs. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. content.original: The Manticore is one of the best-designed and most powerful heavy tanks ever created, built to combat BattleMechs in support of infantry formations. Although the Manticore mounts a variety of weapons to handle a variety of combat roles and ranges, and is heavily armored for a vehicle of its weight, it is not equipped to deal with the raw firepower of Assault weight vehicles such as the Demolisher or the Behemoth. Despite this, the popularity of the Manticore has remained high, even during the Succession Wars era with its use of an expensive and rare Fusion Engine. Originally developed by TechniCorp during the Reunification War, the destruction of the company's head office on Terra during the Amaris Coup spread the Manticore across the Inner Sphere as other manufacturers absorbed their facilities. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Несмотря на то, что «Мантикора» оснащена разнообразным вооружением для выполнения различных боевых задач на разных дистанциях, а также имеет тяжёлую броню для машины своего веса, она не способна справиться с грубой огневой мощью штурмовых машин, таких как «Демолишер» или «Бегемот». Несмотря на это, популярность «Мантикоры» оставалась высокой даже в эпоху Наследных войн благодаря использованию дорогостоящего и редкого термоядерного двигателя. Изначально разработанная компанией TechniCorp во время Объединительной войны, после уничтожения её головного офиса на Терре во время переворота Амариса «Мантикора» распространилась по всей Внутренней Сфере, поскольку другие производители поглотили их заводы. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 4/6 гексов / 120/180 метров. Not only did it share the name of the Lyran Commonwealth's late founding father with the Marsden I, but also its mission profile and much of its general layout. Improved technical and manufacturing knowledge allowed the company to improve the new tank's arms and armor while still making it five tons lighter. With its excellent firepower and thick armor, it was considered a cutting edge combat vehicle when it premiered during the Age of War. The durable Marsden II continued to soldier on in various planetary militias and private security force arsenals into the Succession Wars. The Duchy commissioned Brooks Inc. to create the tank to enable the Duchy's military to fill its military gaps, without relying on outside sources for equipment and parts. The tank is based on the Age of War Augustus A-3 Tank. The tank began production in 3076, and has since been dispersed among the League forces on station in the Duchy. content.original: While often derided as a poor man's Rommel/Patton tank, the simply constructed and dependable Po Heavy Tank, named by Romano Liao for the mischievous and vengeful spirit of Chinese tradition, has become the principal combat vehicle on Capellan worlds lacking 'Mech units. Introduced in 3031, the Po is built around the rugged, dependable, and cheap Ceres 240 internal combustion engine, which gives the tank a maximum flank speed of 65 kph. Ten and half tons of armor provides respectable protection for a heavy tank. Along with its ease of maintenance and decent firepower, this protection has made the Po a popular choice among cash strapped mercenaries, lower ranked garrison units, the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake, with such export sales keeping much needed funds flowing into the Confederation's coffers. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. The original weapons loadout has been removed and replaced with a trio of LRM-15’s augmented by Artemis IV. A pair of Medium Pulse Lasers replace the Medium Lasers. Much like the lack of CASE, designers neglected to improve the Vehicles speed, leaving it with much the same weaknesses as the original model. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: The Saladin Mk II HCV is a redesigned version of the original Third Succession War-era Saladin combat vehicle prized for its hitting power and speed. This new version of the Scarborough Manufacturers' famous line of hovercrafts would be first produced during the mid-thirty-second century. While retaining the speed of the original model, the Saladin MK II is considerably better protected by Scarborough engineers using 5.5 tons of Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Armor. The tank's primary weapon is its front-mounted Magna Flarestar Snub-Nose Particle Projection Cannon. While this has less punch than the original's heavy Autocannon, the PPC has no ammunition needs, allowing it to keep fighting longer and at greater ranges. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: Built by the same company that made the Saracen and Scimitar, the Saladin was Scarborough's last medium hover tank. It is unlike its brothers in that the Saladin does not mount a turret, and its only weapon is a heavy, short-range AC/20. Since it's vastly different from the company's other hovercraft, buyers were quite skeptical about purchasing it; Scarborough had to offer incentives like free training and transportation. Soon it became as cheap as the Saracen and spread throughout the whole Inner Sphere. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. content.original: The ubiquitous Striker finds it's way into the hands of many dubious characters and myriad adhoc field refits exist, generally with whatever missile weapons the user can get their hands on. The Striker Light Tank started out as a joint project venture between Valiant Systems and Wunderland Enterprises on the world of Johnsondale. They united in their efforts to create a joint company known as Valiant Vehicles, with the Striker being their first product. The low cost light fire support tank became a mainstay of the AFFS after its introduction in the first decade of the thirty-first century, and orders for the Striker soon outstripped the Valiant production line's capacity. content.original: In 3052 RISC Engineers took another look at their upgrade of the venerable Zhukov and decided it wasn't RISCy enough. Heavy RAC/5 replaced the reliable LBX/10. A Fuel Cell engine and Heavy Ferrofibrous armor allowed significant upgrades to the survivability and firepower of the reliable Zhukov. In 3030, Aldis Industries deployed the successful follow up to its venerable Demolisher design, the slightly lighter Zhukov. While it shares many of the parts and features of the design that inspired it, the Zhukov is smaller, better armored, and packs less weaponry than its predecessor. Its first major deployment was with the Wolf's Dragoons whereupon the Zhukov has since seen constant improvements and tweaks as suggested to Aldis Industries by the field units that use it. The Zhukov's strength is its relative simplicity. Two turret mounted SarLon MaxiCannon Autocannon/10s are more than adequate at providing sufficient firepower for the discriminating buyer while imitating its larger cousin the Demolisher. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: The Anzu was well-regarded by both MechWarriors and technicians for its reliability; the AMSC found the Anzu to be a good fit for the aggressive combat tactics they had developed since the Jihad. Although the Anzu's maximum ground speed was 64 kph, the Chilton 465 Jump Jets allowed the Anzu to jump up to 120 meters. The Anzu mounted eleven tons of Starshield A Standard Armor with CASE II built in to protect the 'Mech and its pilot from ammunition explosions. The Anzu also used the same life support systems as the Shadow Hawk, already well-proven by the time the Anzu entered service, and the RCA Instatrac Mark X targeting and tracking system allowed the Anzu to simultaneously engage multiple targets while also spotting for indirect fire through the installed TAG system. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Anzu was well-regarded by both MechWarriors and technicians for its reliability; the AMSC found the Anzu to be a good fit for the aggressive combat tactics they had developed since the Jihad. Although the Anzu's maximum ground speed was 64 kph, the Chilton 465 Jump Jets allowed the Anzu to jump up to 120 meters. The Anzu mounted eleven tons of Starshield A Standard Armor with CASE II built in to protect the 'Mech and its pilot from ammunition explosions. The Anzu also used the same life support systems as the Shadow Hawk, already well-proven by the time the Anzu entered service, and the RCA Instatrac Mark X targeting and tracking system allowed the Anzu to simultaneously engage multiple targets while also spotting for indirect fire through the installed TAG system.

content.original: The Awesome is traditionally used in a vanguard role when penetrating enemy defenses. The Awesome's massive firepower also lends it to defensive actions, acting as a mobile turret when necessary. Because of its reliance on PPCs, the Awesome is able to act independently for extended periods of time. This trait is also useful in siege situations where the 'Mech can keep up a constant barrage, allowing it to win battles of attrition through bleeding an enemy dry. The only downsides to the Awesome is its low maneuverability and lack of rear-facing weaponry, making it vulnerable to being outflanked and surrounded by lighter 'Mechs, although good intelligence and a well-deployed screening force can mitigate this issue.
