Массивная огневая мощь Awesome также позволяет использовать его в оборонительных действиях, при необходимости выступая в роли мобильной турели. Благодаря использованию PPC, Awesome способен действовать автономно в течение длительного времени. Эта особенность также полезна в осадных ситуациях, когда мехи могут вести постоянный обстрел, позволяя выигрывать битвы на истощение за счет обескровливания противника. Единственным недостатком Awesome является низкая маневренность и отсутствие заднего оружия, что делает его уязвимым для захода и обстрела в спину более легкими мехами, хотя хорошая разведка и хорошо развернутые силы прикрытия могут смягчить эту проблему.

content.original: While the primitive Dervish 1S was decommissioned from military use throughout the Inner Sphere by 2990s, it experienced a resurgence in the Periphery in the civilian sector. The Dervish 1S-F is a makeshift design initially cobbled together from scrap heaps but later produced as a standard variant on low-tech worlds. Primarily designed to start controlled fires in remote areas, the loadout of the 1S heavily favors incendiary weapons. With a top speed of only 64 km/h the unit cannot out-run fires, so the cockpit is designed with additional heat shielding and environment controls. The limited jump range of 120 meters is sufficient to navigate ravines and other natural obstacles. Due to the civilian control several units have fallen into pirate or rebel hands and are used as makeshift terror platforms. Frequently used for extortion, the design has come to be known as the 'Bandit' through those areas where it remains common. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: An almost total refitting of a Banshee by a crazed ex-gladiator from Solaris VII resulted in the monostrosity known as the "Pyromaniac". The combination of a heat specific FCS and the armament of 4 Plasma Cannons, two Heavy Flamers, two Inferno-firing SRM-6 launchers and a head mounted flamer, all very heavily modified, shows why the 'Mech was given its name. Boosting a 375 ton XXL fusion engine makes the "Pyromaniac" more mobile than expected as well, combined with heavy armor making it a fearsome sight to spot on the battlefield. The downside of all this equipment is that both the center torso and the head has been utilized to fit the required ammo and no C.A.S.E system is installed. But this is just yet another sign how crazy the 'Mechs creator was. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

The combination of a heat specific FCS and the armament of 4 Plasma Cannons, two Heavy Flamers, two Inferno-firing SRM-6 launchers and a head mounted flamer, all very heavily modified, shows why the 'Mech was given its name. Boosting a 375 ton XXL fusion engine makes the "Pyromaniac" more mobile than expected as well, combined with heavy armor making it a fearsome sight to spot on the battlefield. The downside of all this equipment is that both the center torso and the head has been utilized to fit the required ammo and no C.A.S.E system is installed. But this is just yet another sign how crazy the 'Mechs creator was. Особенность: Боевые кулаки Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.19

content.original: The Centurion OmniMech was born out of a desire on the part of Corean Enterprises to expand the company's market share. Manufactured primarily at the Corean Enterprises' site on New Avalon and weighing in at 50 tons, the Centurion mounted a Magna 250 XL engine, allowing it to run at 86 km/h, and mounts nine and a half tons of standard armor. With ten fixed double heat sinks, the Centurion has 24 tons of pod space available, almost half the total weight of the 'Mech, and the most common variants of the Centurion echo the various variants of the original Centurion BattleMech developed over the centuries. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The earliest version used standard heat sinks and its Primitive Engine could only manage 30 km/h. This proved to be a challenge as the early Helepolis needed to completely stop to fire the Sniper artillery and then start moving again before counter-battery fire could destroy the unit. Twenty and a half tons of Primitive Armor protected the Helepolis from enemy fire. The weight and bulk of the primitive systems prevented the designers from installing the long range missiles used on later models.

Even the cockpit got changed to include 2 red buttons with words scratched above, such as 'more missiles' and 'all the missiles', which I believe probably controls the weapons firing modes. This Hollander has been so badly maintained that its housing can't support a ballistic of any kind, and a huge missile launcher has been mounted in the torso instead. The arms carry surprisingly advanced X-Pulse lasers, and the heatsink kit has been "upgraded" in an attempt to cool it all. In the spirit of a normal Hollander, all this firepower is protected by only minimal armor. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Стандарт Внутренней Сферы был разработан после вторжения Кланов, когда державы Внутренней Сферы спешили воспроизвести технологию боевой брони Кланов. Однако, не имея никаких частей с полей сражений, инженеры были вынуждены работать на основе древних слухов о ранних силовых бронекостюмах типа Nighthawk, больше похожих на бронированные экзоскелеты, чем на тех «жаб», что встречались им в настоящее время, и их прототипы плохо показывали себя во время испытаний. Настоящий толчок в изучении боевой брони дали трофеи с первых побед над Кланами. Научный институт Нового Авалона первым частично воспроизвел броню элементалей в виде Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: For once Pirate Lingo makes sense on a Mech, the Bilge Rat is exactly like the archaic Rodent it gets its name from. Relying on a mixture of speed and EWAR does this Quad Mech try to skim under the Radar and hide in the murky depths of a Chaotic Battlefield. Showing some bite when threatened the Mech packs several MRM 5's with paired Chem Lasers wired through the cockpit. Whoever designed the couplings made the machine a bumpy ride at best with the fumes leading straight into the Cockpit. I can only compare this to huffing a Marker while trying to run for your Life, unless the Engine explodes underneath you in true PiraSte Fashion. Someone carved 'Cheese and Sin' in the cockpit's interior as well. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

content.original: This Blakist Jihad Stalking Spider has been made into a Work of Art to be honest. The Eight Improved Jump jets are still in, but rewired, redistributed and a little bit improved. Somewhere they found some Wings and bolted them on too. All of the 4 Legs in this Quad have been upgraded to the extreme. I'm talking about special Actuators, Talons and Jump Jets in each. Nearly all of the weaponry has been removed, except for a Single Laser that looks like it's going to fall off any second, with some bolted on Inferno Rockets. The Heatsinks and the Gyro have been both upgraded, The Engine was downsized and rewired to go into the Jump Jets to increase the Flight Time. The Cockpit has, too, been reworked and been given a Hotseat, Sensors for Increased Flight Calculations and a Gladiator FCS. I can Tell you one Thing, if this Thing starts flying, it will be one hell of a Bullet. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: All of the offensive weaponry on this Ursa has been replaced or broken down. The Medium Pulse lasers have been 'piratified' and put into the Left and Right Torso, while the RAC2 was wholly replaced by a Pirate AC20 with Stabilized Housing, but i'm not even sure it's going to help that much. They put in some kind of TAG System in the Head but its taking up a lot of space. The MASC and XL engine have been ripped out to make space for some kind of Fuel intake for a Nitro Canister to increase its speed. Parts of the Armour have been lined with Spalling, to decrease Shrapnel that might come off of this thing for whatever Reason. There is also a Double Heatsink kit in there, to my surprise. This thing will blow itself up anyway as soon as that Nitro reaches the Core. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

Just don't ask what it was made of in the start, i can't even tell the wiring apart, the Idiots took off the Colours of the wires. A MASC made its way into this too, for catching up when they 'Fly too fast.' Does he know there aren't any Whales in Space? Are we missing the bigger picture here Boss, or was this Pirate just on too many Drugs at once? Even the onboard information says he hunted 6 of them down, but no Pictures. content.original: Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. The first of what became commonly referred to as the Zeus X series, the ZEU-X was a variant of the venerable Zeus BattleMech developed using Experimental Technology to push the envelope of the original design. How this thing came to be in pirate hands we may never know. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Designed solely as an artillery vehicle, the Ballista mounts a Sniper Artillery piece in the turret; supplied with 3 tons of ammo. The Ballista's secondary weaponry consists of three Machine Guns, two mounted forward and one in the rear of the tank. Powered by a 165-rated Internal Combustion Engine, the vehicle is able to keep up at modest pace with other mobile support elements. Protecting the Ballista's hull is 7.5 tons of armor, giving adequate protection against enemy fire should opposing forces manage to penetrate deeply behind friendly battle lines. content.original: A tank formerly owned by filthy and demented pirates is the last place you'd expect a Shakespeare reference, but here we are. Renowned for its heavy punch, the Brutus Assault Tank features an impressive combination of long and short range firepower. Powered by a Rawlings 225 Fusion Engine with a top speed of 54kph, the Brutus compares well to other fusion engine equipped tanks of similar weight and role like the Von Luckner and Manticore, though most variants are more lightly armored in exchange for a heavier weapons array. Despite its abilities, the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces remained lukewarm on the design. However it eventually found an enthusiastic user base among the Federated Suns. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: This is a pirate field refit of the old SLDF Demon PPC variant. The cannons are mismatched. It's hard to say if this was intentional or just what they had on hand. The Demon was originally created by the SLDF as its standard fighting vehicle in 2716. A match for any light or medium BattleMech, the Demon had good maneuverability and was protected by ten tons of slab armor, most of it concentrated in its front. Due to the nature of its powerful main weapon the Demon was often used in ambush attacks and fought in pairs instead of the usual four-vehicle lance. The vehicle's main disadvantage was its lack of speed, which made it vulnerable to faster 'Mechs and other vehicles able to maneuver around and engage its weaker rear armor. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: Unsurprisingly an urban fighting IFV is like Ignis is fairly popular with pirates. This one has been 'upgraded' with some custom flamers. Designed by United Mechanics, LLC on Apollo for the Rim Worlds Republic as an anti-insurgent vehicle. Originally based on an infantry personnel carrier, it was designed for urban assault against urban shelters. The vehicle was used to ram its target buildings so it could deliver its infantry squad into the breached structure. Originally named the Ram, the vehicle crews during its original time of use, came to use another name. It was referred to as the Ignis, with flamers reminding them of the Vedic god of fire. content.original: The Kamakiri mounts three weapon systems mounted in the front of the VTOL - a single Tiegart Particle Projection Cannon and a pair of Telos ThunderShot Thunderbolt 10 Missile Launchers. The Kamakiri Attack VTOL was developed at the end of the thirty-first century by Yan Manufacturing of New Samarkand as a result of their growing success in the military aerospace market. Dubbed as resembling a praying mantis, the Kamakiri was an immediate success; the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery personnel responsible for supervising the first vehicle trial watched for just two minutes before approving the Kamakiri for purchase. Moving as fast as many reconnaissance and strike platforms in service with the DCMS already thanks to the DAV 155 XL extra light engine, the original specification armor installed by Yan was replaced with seven tons of StarGuard Aurora Reflective at the request of the DCMS, who wanted to improve the Kamakari's protection against energy weapons, although the nature of the Reflective Armor didn't offer any additional protection against the flak commonly directed at VTOLs. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. content.original: The Manticore is one of the best-designed and most powerful heavy tanks ever created, built to combat BattleMechs in support of infantry formations. Although the Manticore mounts a variety of weapons to handle a variety of combat roles and ranges, and is heavily armored for a vehicle of its weight, it is not equipped to deal with the raw firepower of Assault weight vehicles such as the Demolisher or the Behemoth. Despite this, the popularity of the Manticore has remained high, even during the Succession Wars era with its use of an expensive and rare Fusion Engine. Originally developed by TechniCorp during the Reunification War, the destruction of the company's head office on Terra during the Amaris Coup spread the Manticore across the Inner Sphere as other manufacturers absorbed their facilities. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Несмотря на то, что «Мантикора» оснащена разнообразным вооружением для выполнения различных боевых задач на разных дистанциях, а также имеет тяжёлую броню для машины своего веса, она не способна справиться с грубой огневой мощью штурмовых машин, таких как «Демолишер» или «Бегемот». Несмотря на это, популярность «Мантикоры» оставалась высокой даже в эпоху Наследных войн благодаря использованию дорогостоящего и редкого термоядерного двигателя. Изначально разработанная компанией TechniCorp во время Объединительной войны, после уничтожения её головного офиса на Терре во время переворота Амариса «Мантикора» распространилась по всей Внутренней Сфере, поскольку другие производители поглотили их заводы. content.original: The Manticore is one of the best-designed and most powerful heavy tanks ever created, built to combat BattleMechs in support of infantry formations. Although the Manticore mounts a variety of weapons to handle a variety of combat roles and ranges, and is heavily armored for a vehicle of its weight, it is not equipped to deal with the raw firepower of Assault weight vehicles such as the Demolisher or the Behemoth. Despite this, the popularity of the Manticore has remained high, even during the Succession Wars era with its use of an expensive and rare Fusion Engine. Originally developed by TechniCorp during the Reunification War, the destruction of the company's head office on Terra during the Amaris Coup spread the Manticore across the Inner Sphere as other manufacturers absorbed their facilities. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. content.original: The Marsden II Main Battle Tank was introduced by Arcturan Arms in 2463 to improve upon and replace its venerable predecessor after seventy years of frontline service. Not only did it share the name of the Lyran Commonwealth's late founding father with the Marsden I, but also its mission profile and much of its general layout. Improved technical and manufacturing knowledge allowed the company to improve the new tank's arms and armor while still making it five tons lighter. With its excellent firepower and thick armor, it was considered a cutting edge combat vehicle when it premiered during the Age of War. The durable Marsden II continued to soldier on in various planetary militias and private security force arsenals into the Succession Wars. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: While often derided as a poor man's Rommel/Patton tank, the simply constructed and dependable Po Heavy Tank, named by Romano Liao for the mischievous and vengeful spirit of Chinese tradition, has become the principal combat vehicle on Capellan worlds lacking 'Mech units. Introduced in 3031, the Po is built around the rugged, dependable, and cheap Ceres 240 internal combustion engine, which gives the tank a maximum flank speed of 65 kph. Ten and half tons of armor provides respectable protection for a heavy tank. Along with its ease of maintenance and decent firepower, this protection has made the Po a popular choice among cash strapped mercenaries, lower ranked garrison units, the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake, with such export sales keeping much needed funds flowing into the Confederation's coffers. content.original: Rolling off the production line in 3052, the Rhino (3052) Upgrade is a complete rework of the original design, designed to make effective use of rediscovered Star League technology. The original weapons loadout has been removed and replaced with a trio of LRM-15’s augmented by Artemis IV. A pair of Medium Pulse Lasers replace the Medium Lasers. Much like the lack of CASE, designers neglected to improve the Vehicles speed, leaving it with much the same weaknesses as the original model. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: The Saladin Mk II HCV is a redesigned version of the original Third Succession War-era Saladin combat vehicle prized for its hitting power and speed. This new version of the Scarborough Manufacturers' famous line of hovercrafts would be first produced during the mid-thirty-second century. While retaining the speed of the original model, the Saladin MK II is considerably better protected by Scarborough engineers using 5.5 tons of Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Armor. The tank's primary weapon is its front-mounted Magna Flarestar Snub-Nose Particle Projection Cannon. While this has less punch than the original's heavy Autocannon, the PPC has no ammunition needs, allowing it to keep fighting longer and at greater ranges. Biome Restrictions: None. Эта новая версия знаменитой линейки машин на воздушной подушке от Scarborough Manufacturers впервые была выпущена в середине 32 века. Сохраняя скорость оригинальной модели, Saladin MK II значительно лучше защищён инженерами Scarborough, используя 5,5 тонн тяжёлой ферроволоконной брони. Основное оружие танка — фронтальная пушка Magna Flarestar Snub-Nose Particle Projection Cannon. Хотя её мощность меньше, чем у тяжёлой автопушки оригинала, зато PPC не нуждается в боеприпасах, что позволяет вести бой дольше и на больших дистанциях. Ограничения биома: нет. content.original: The ubiquitous Striker finds it's way into the hands of many dubious characters and myriad adhoc field refits exist, generally with whatever missile weapons the user can get their hands on. The Striker Light Tank started out as a joint project venture between Valiant Systems and Wunderland Enterprises on the world of Johnsondale. They united in their efforts to create a joint company known as Valiant Vehicles, with the Striker being their first product. The low cost light fire support tank became a mainstay of the AFFS after its introduction in the first decade of the thirty-first century, and orders for the Striker soon outstripped the Valiant production line's capacity. content.content: «Йеллоу Жакет» был построен на базе Poland Model C пушки Гаусса. Последующие версии оснащались другими системами, но в целом он по-прежнему представлял собой технику с одним тяжёлым стволом. content.original: In 3052 RISC Engineers took another look at their upgrade of the venerable Zhukov and decided it wasn't RISCy enough. Heavy RAC/5 replaced the reliable LBX/10. A Fuel Cell engine and Heavy Ferrofibrous armor allowed significant upgrades to the survivability and firepower of the reliable Zhukov. In 3030, Aldis Industries deployed the successful follow up to its venerable Demolisher design, the slightly lighter Zhukov. While it shares many of the parts and features of the design that inspired it, the Zhukov is smaller, better armored, and packs less weaponry than its predecessor. Its first major deployment was with the Wolf's Dragoons whereupon the Zhukov has since seen constant improvements and tweaks as suggested to Aldis Industries by the field units that use it. The Zhukov's strength is its relative simplicity. Two turret mounted SarLon MaxiCannon Autocannon/10s are more than adequate at providing sufficient firepower for the discriminating buyer while imitating its larger cousin the Demolisher. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: A prototype LAM, the Ajax was a next generation Star League design. Following relatively successful initial trials, the Amaris Civil War rendered the design extinct; with production and testing ceasing due to the war. Designed to be easy to maintain, the Ajax uses pod mounted weapons similar to the modular weapons designed for the Mercury scout Mech. Able to switch modes faster than standard LAM designs, the Ajax has a less extensive transformation process; a benefit of the next generation technology used to create the Mech. content.original: The Anzu was well-regarded by both MechWarriors and technicians for its reliability; the AMSC found the Anzu to be a good fit for the aggressive combat tactics they had developed since the Jihad. Although the Anzu's maximum ground speed was 64 kph, the Chilton 465 Jump Jets allowed the Anzu to jump up to 120 meters. The Anzu mounted eleven tons of Starshield A Standard Armor with CASE II built in to protect the 'Mech and its pilot from ammunition explosions. The Anzu also used the same life support systems as the Shadow Hawk, already well-proven by the time the Anzu entered service, and the RCA Instatrac Mark X targeting and tracking system allowed the Anzu to simultaneously engage multiple targets while also spotting for indirect fire through the installed TAG system. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: While the primitive Dervish 1S was decommissioned from military use throughout the Inner Sphere by 2990s, it experienced a resurgence in the Periphery in the civilian sector. The Dervish 1S-F is a makeshift design initially cobbled together from scrap heaps but later produced as a standard variant on low-tech worlds. Primarily designed to start controlled fires in remote areas, the loadout of the 1S heavily favors incendiary weapons. With a top speed of only 64 km/h the unit cannot out-run fires, so the cockpit is designed with additional heat shielding and environment controls. The limited jump range of 120 meters is sufficient to navigate ravines and other natural obstacles. Due to the civilian control several units have fallen into pirate or rebel hands and are used as makeshift terror platforms. Frequently used for extortion, the design has come to be known as the 'Bandit' through those areas where it remains common. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: An almost total refitting of a Banshee by a crazed ex-gladiator from Solaris VII resulted in the monostrosity known as the "Pyromaniac". The combination of a heat specific FCS and the armament of 4 Plasma Cannons, two Heavy Flamers, two Inferno-firing SRM-6 launchers and a head mounted flamer, all very heavily modified, shows why the 'Mech was given its name. Boosting a 375 ton XXL fusion engine makes the "Pyromaniac" more mobile than expected as well, combined with heavy armor making it a fearsome sight to spot on the battlefield. The downside of all this equipment is that both the center torso and the head has been utilized to fit the required ammo and no C.A.S.E system is installed. But this is just yet another sign how crazy the 'Mechs creator was. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

content.original: The Centurion OmniMech was born out of a desire on the part of Corean Enterprises to expand the company's market share. Manufactured primarily at the Corean Enterprises' site on New Avalon and weighing in at 50 tons, the Centurion mounted a Magna 250 XL engine, allowing it to run at 86 km/h, and mounts nine and a half tons of standard armor. With ten fixed double heat sinks, the Centurion has 24 tons of pod space available, almost half the total weight of the 'Mech, and the most common variants of the Centurion echo the various variants of the original Centurion BattleMech developed over the centuries. content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Стандарт Внутренней Сферы был разработан после вторжения Кланов, когда державы Внутренней Сферы спешили воспроизвести технологию боевой брони Кланов. Однако, не имея никаких частей с полей сражений, инженеры были вынуждены работать на основе древних слухов о ранних силовых бронекостюмах типа Nighthawk, больше похожих на бронированные экзоскелеты, чем на тех «жаб», что встречались им в настоящее время, и их прототипы плохо показывали себя во время испытаний. Настоящий толчок в изучении боевой брони дали трофеи с первых побед над Кланами. Научный институт Нового Авалона первым частично воспроизвел броню элементалей в виде Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: For once Pirate Lingo makes sense on a Mech, the Bilge Rat is exactly like the archaic Rodent it gets its name from. Relying on a mixture of speed and EWAR does this Quad Mech try to skim under the Radar and hide in the murky depths of a Chaotic Battlefield. Showing some bite when threatened the Mech packs several MRM 5's with paired Chem Lasers wired through the cockpit. Whoever designed the couplings made the machine a bumpy ride at best with the fumes leading straight into the Cockpit. I can only compare this to huffing a Marker while trying to run for your Life, unless the Engine explodes underneath you in true PiraSte Fashion. Someone carved 'Cheese and Sin' in the cockpit's interior as well. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

content.original: This Blakist Jihad Stalking Spider has been made into a Work of Art to be honest. The Eight Improved Jump jets are still in, but rewired, redistributed and a little bit improved. Somewhere they found some Wings and bolted them on too. All of the 4 Legs in this Quad have been upgraded to the extreme. I'm talking about special Actuators, Talons and Jump Jets in each. Nearly all of the weaponry has been removed, except for a Single Laser that looks like it's going to fall off any second, with some bolted on Inferno Rockets. The Heatsinks and the Gyro have been both upgraded, The Engine was downsized and rewired to go into the Jump Jets to increase the Flight Time. The Cockpit has, too, been reworked and been given a Hotseat, Sensors for Increased Flight Calculations and a Gladiator FCS. I can Tell you one Thing, if this Thing starts flying, it will be one hell of a Bullet. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.content: Изготовленный на заводе Defiance в Кванжон-ни, Zeus X стал одновременно образцом совершенства в области производственной инженерии и инновационной высокотехнологичной платформой. Первый из серии, получившей общее название Zeus X, ZEU-X представлял собой модификацию почтенного боевого меха Zeus, разработанную с использованием экспериментальных технологий, чтобы расширить возможности оригинальной конструкции. Как эта штука оказалась в руках пиратов, мы, вероятно, никогда не узнаем. Особенность: Командирский мех Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.21 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The "Creep" - named for the ability to deliver a deadly barrage as it creeps through the shadows under stealth. Built as a pet project by someone at RISC with too much money and a hate-boner for the Clans, this Blood Asp had a pile of advanced tech bolted to it and was turned inside-out in the image of the Inner Sphere. The "Creep" retains the Blood Asp's frontline assault role, albeit with a little more trickery. Keep the front toward the enemy and tape down that trigger block. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Ebon Jaguar OmniMech was code-named "Cauldron-Born" by the Inner Sphere - a name taken from Irish legend to describe immortal, unstoppable undead. The unique armor fitted to this particular chassis certainly fits the bill, being described as "living" ferro-fibrous plating by members of the DCMS who encountered it. In actuality, the armor is closer to Hardened Armor impregnated with HarJel, but the average grunt cares not for the specifics. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Wolfman was first created by Valdis Ullman, a MechWarrior belonging to the Legion of Vega, on Bergman's Planet during the Second Battle of Ryersson in 2986. Originally piloting a Wolverine, his BattleMech was damaged in a fight with a Davion Marauder, with most of its upper body damaged or destroyed. Fortunately, a Davion Rifleman had been destroyed only a hundred meters away from his 'Mech. The Rifleman had suffered damage to its torso and legs. Ullman's personal technician, Sharis Brand thought that the two 'Mechs could be merged together, taking the intact legs and hips from Ullman's Wolverine and combining it with the torso and arms from the Rifleman. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

The Blue Flame is an extremely stable platform due to its quadrupedal configuration. In the later years of the Jihad, an engineer who had helped build the 'Mech stole the design specs and later created the Thunder Fox.

content.original: Boss, I know some people like fire, but this 'Mech is going too far. I swear the universe stuttered when we did a test run the other day. Anyway, you want to commit some ecological crimes, indulge your inner arsonist? *slap* This is the mech for it. You want to cross into potentially heretical stuff by calling it the "Burning Bushy", stare into the massive field of flames you ignited until they start talking to you. Well, Quicksell sells a kit to have the name engraved, and some totally-legit-not-hallucinogenic mushrooms. No, we're not ordering it. I already get enough hate-mail and bio-bombs because I called Blake a crummy engineer on that late night holoshow.

content.content: Босс, я знаю, что некоторые люди любят огонь, но с этим мехом они зашли слишком далеко. Клянусь, вселенная начала заикаться, когда мы провели пробный запуск на днях. Ладно, хотите совершить экологическое преступление, побаловать своего внутреннего поджигателя? [щелкает пальцами и указывает на меха] Этот мех для вас. Хотите, зовите его «Горящий куст» (Burning Bushy), только не удивляйтесь, когда будете глядеть на массивное поле пламени, оставленное после вас, если огонь начнёт с вами говорить. Ну, то есть, Quicksell также продаёт набор для гравировки имени и какие-то «абсолютно-легальные-не-галлюциногенные» грибы. Нет, мы не будем их заказывать. Я и так получил достаточно писем ненависти и био-бомб за то, что назвал Блейка плохим инженером на том позднем ночном голошоу.

content.original: Weighing in at 10 tons each, the ultralight Corgi Squad makes use of all the weight-saving technology available to the Clans. Each unit mounts a custom 100-rated extralight fusion engine capable of speeds of up to 160km/h and an endo steel frame, saving weight for ten standard heat sinks. The squad's offensive loadout is also fearsome given the individual 'Mech's light weight - collectively the squad operates a standard size clan LB 20-X autocannon, with two additional one-shot ATM-3 launchers available for emergencies. Two tons of reloads for the LB 20-X ensure that the bark is certainly not worse than the bite. Woof woof! Quirk: Corgi Squad Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08

content.original: Personal ride of MechWarrior Pembroke, one of the youngest members of Clan Spaniel. Pembroke had a reputation as a brash and scrappy warrior and was most well known for chasing retreating Five Evil Monkey Tribe 'Mechs and herding them back to face honorable combat. To aid her in her task, her Corgi, the Cardigan, was extensively modified - mounting Five Monkey active probes to allow her to showcase the superiority of Clan technology. Though she hoped to prove she had what it takes to become Khan, her tactics attracted the attention of the Five Monkey Tribes, who would send hunter-killer Flea units after her. To aid her in her task, her Corgi, the Cardigan, was extensively modified - mounting Five Monkey active probes to allow her to showcase the superiority of Clan technology. Though she hoped to prove she had what it takes to become Khan, her tactics attracted the attention of the Five Monkey Tribes, who would send hunter-killer Flea units after her.

content.original: Boss, they're hyping up this Quicsell Hunchback QSK with double AC/20s and speedy legs, but those 'advanced compact X4 arm actuators'? You'd practically miss every shot – like handing someone a sledgehammer for darts. And those speedy legs? The Mech might tip over if someone sneezes. It's all flashy promises, but I'd tread lightly. This Mech could be more spectacle than powerhouse on the battlefield.

content.original: In this age of ECM and information warfare, you can't trust your sensors. But what can you trust? Your eyes. And here at QuicSell, we know just the thing for up-and-coming Mercs who are looking to make a name for themselves! With our Stormcrow model, your opponents will know they've picked the wrong battle from the moment they see you. Fielding the same* technology the Clans use, enjoy this Omnimech** in battle, and feel free to swap weapons out as you desire***. Worried about fancy Clan tech being too difficult for your maintenance crews? We've got that covered too, with easy-to-use tags and markings on all cabling. Remember folks, first impressions matter, and can decide the battle. Don't choose poorly, choose 'Clan QuickSell'(tm). Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

И, поверьте, здесь, в QuicSell, мы знаем, что нужно начинающим наёмникам, которые хотят прославиться! С нашей моделью Stormcrow ваши противники сразу поймут, что они выбрали не ту битву. Волнуетесь, что ваши ремонтные бригады не справятся с этими мудрёными клановыми технологиями? Мы позаботились и об этом, нанеся простые в использовании метки и маркировку на все кабели. И запомните, господа, первое впечатление имеет значение и может решить исход битвы. Не выбирайте плохое, выбирайте Clan QuickSell. content.original: Boss, this is a... Timber Cat? Is this wood? This IS wood! Who put wood into the structure? And are those decorative ears on the missile launchers? How does this not explode into fire when hot? How does that wood even survive the stresses of a mech? I can't believe QuicSell somehow developed some sort of magical wood that worked. And I have to order parts from them, can't replace it with stuff I find. Well, at least the weaponry is good. Those Streak PPCs are some of my favorite weapons, and the REX laser series is just exquisite.

Как оно не сгорело от жары? Как это дерево вообще выдерживает нагрузки меха? Не могу поверить, что QuicSell каким-то образом разработали какое-то волшебное дерево. А ещё приходится заказывать детали только у них, я не могу заменить их ничем другим. Что ж, по крайней мере, оружие хорошее. Эти Streak РРС — одни из моих любимых, а лазеры серии REX просто восхитительны.

content.original: Everyone knows a LAM should just shoot and scoot, and here at QuicSell, we make that easy. Picking up a great deal on some Warhammer LAM parts, we decided to focus on an often ignored segment: periphery Heavy-LAM use. Knowing that you can't always find a machine shop, the Warhammer LAM QS comes with a patented hardwood frame originally seen on the 'Spruce Goose' WiGE, allowing even the most basic worlds to provide structural repair. Focusing on that initial impulse of damage, we've swapped out the dangerous ammo-laden missiles for everyone's favorite! Rockets! These are coupled with a pair of LBX PPC's to ensure better accuracy on strafing runs, as well as a modest bomb bay that we stock with even more rockets. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Lightened structure for agility, sure, but chemical lasers mean you're playing with volatile ammo. And that laser AMS? It sounds like a lot of glitz for a Wolfhound. Особенность: Надёжное вооружение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.03

content.original: Quicksell knows pilots like fire, and is happy to provide. The BSW-QSK brings two of Quicksell's newest plasma-based weaponry, the Plasma Scattergun - guaranteed to melt any opposition, to the field. Targets still standing in that sea of flame? We've included a light mortar and REX Laser to help clean up anything remaining. Our classic Viewmaster Cockpit provides the widest field of view, ensuring pilots will become entranced by the wonders of the FLAME. Please do not use Quicksell equipment to found any sort of group that may result in stern letters being written to us. Yes - that includes an 'Extreme' S'mores Making Club. Please send us any s'mores though. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: «Квикселл» знает, что пилоты любят огонь, и готовы с радостью его предоставить. BSW-QSK несёт на себе новейшее плазменное оружие Quicksell, два Plasma Scattergun, которые гарантированно расплавят любого на поле боя. Что? Цели всё ещё стоят, в этом море пламени? content.original: Weighing in at 10 tons each, the ultralight Corgi Squad makes use of all the weight-saving technology available to the Clans. Each unit mounts a custom 100-rated extralight fusion engine capable of speeds of up to 160km/h and an endo steel frame, saving weight for ten standard heat sinks. The squad's offensive loadout is also fearsome given the individual 'Mech's light weight - collectively the squad operates a standard size clan LB 20-X autocannon, with two additional one-shot ATM-3 launchers available for emergencies. Two tons of reloads for the LB 20-X ensure that the bark is certainly not worse than the bite. Woof woof! Quirk: Corgi Squad Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08

content.original: Personal ride of MechWarrior Pembroke, one of the youngest members of Clan Spaniel. Pembroke had a reputation as a brash and scrappy warrior and was most well known for chasing retreating Five Evil Monkey Tribe 'Mechs and herding them back to face honorable combat. To aid her in her task, her Corgi, the Cardigan, was extensively modified - mounting Five Monkey active probes to allow her to showcase the superiority of Clan technology. Though she hoped to prove she had what it takes to become Khan, her tactics attracted the attention of the Five Monkey Tribes, who would send hunter-killer Flea units after her. Quirk: Corgi Squad Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: Everyone knows a LAM should just shoot and scoot, and here at QuicSell, we make that easy. Picking up a great deal on some Warhammer LAM parts, we decided to focus on an often ignored segment: periphery Heavy-LAM use. Knowing that you can't always find a machine shop, the Warhammer LAM QS comes with a patented hardwood frame originally seen on the 'Spruce Goose' WiGE, allowing even the most basic worlds to provide structural repair. Focusing on that initial impulse of damage, we've swapped out the dangerous ammo-laden missiles for everyone's favorite! Rockets! These are coupled with a pair of LBX PPC's to ensure better accuracy on strafing runs, as well as a modest bomb bay that we stock with even more rockets. content.original: The Rogue Bear 'Baracas' was modified by Bearing Banacek after having spent time amongst Ghost Bear Dominion warriors. He recognised the family atmosphere of the Ghost Bears was similar to the easy fraternal attitude within Star Adder. He isolated himself to redesign the Rogue Bear Battle Armor into one he could personally use in combat. Heavily Armored, with stealth, upgraded sensors and armed with heavy VibroClaws, MicroPulse Lasers and a PPC, the Baracas is able to strike without warning. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: LAST RITES, a modified Minsk 102, is the personal battlemech of legendary MechWarrior saKhan Burt O'Nias' and is built to his personal combat style. Dominion engineers were instructed to remove the Active Probe and upgrade the engine to a Clan XL. The core was increased for more power to a 270 and boosting speed further with the addtion of a Supercharger. With a disdain towards energy loadouts, the mech was retooled to mount Twin Gauss Rifles (C), 5x AP Gauss Rifles and a pair of SRM6 (C) launchers. Quirk: Command Mech Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

This mech was made specifically for him as his personal battlemech and is built to his personal combat style, which means no lasers. Ghost Bear Dominion engineers were instructed to remove the Active Probe and upgrade the engine to a Clan XL. The core was increased for more power to a 270 and boosts speed further with the addtion of a Supercharger. Weapon loadouts include Twin Gauss Rifles (C), 5x AP Gauss Rifles, and a pair of SRM6 (C) launchers.

content.original: Entering service in 3024, the 25 ton Durga was developed by the Hell's Horses as a heavier version of the Donar Assault Helicopter. Weighing 4 tons more then it's predecessor, the Durga is built around a 110 rated XL Engine, making it faster then the lighter Donar. Armed with an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-15, 2 Medium Pulse Lasers and a Small Pulse Laser, the Durga is built for long range engagements; whilst still possessing a potent short range punch. Defensively an ECM Suite and Ferro Fibrous armour protect the Durga. Manufactured by both the Hell's Horses and the Diamond Sharks, the Durga has spread throughout the Clans and most field at least 1 star of them. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. content.original: Designed as a replacement for the earlier Svantovit APC, the 40 ton Eris entered service in 2999. 5 tons heavier then it's predecessor, the Eris is slightly slower with a top speed of 140kph instead of 160kph, but carries twice as much armour as the Svantovit. Powered by a Fuel Cell, the Eris is armed with a pair of LRM-5’s. 4 Machine Guns and 2 Vehicle Flamers provide covering fire for disembarking troops and an Active Probe spots hidden opponents. In use by every Clan, the Eris is a common sight on the battlefield and often finds a use as a cargo transport when not in combat. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. content.original: Designed to fill a need for a heavily armoured and armoured assault transport, the 100 ton Ganesha can carry several points of Elementals or other Battle Armour while shaking off all but the heaviest of hits. Powered by a 300 rated XL Engine, the Ganesha has 19.5 tons of Ferro Fibrous armour and can reach a top speed of 50kph. Armed with a Large Pulse Laser and 2 Streak SRM-6’s, the Ganesha mounts 2 Vehicle Flamers and an AMS on the tanks front. Another Vehicle Flamer and AMS cover the tanks rear. An ECM Suite, Armoured Motive system and a Bulldozer blade add to the tanks protection, while a combination of Tag and an Active Probe allow the tank to work with other forces. Fielded mainly by the Hell's Horses, the Ghost Bears are the only other known user. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: The 30 ton Kali is designed as a heavy gunship and scout hunter. Built around a 130 rated XL engine that propels the Kali to 144kph and boasting 3.5 tons of Ferro Fibrous armour; the Kali can match speeds with the Durga and Donar Helicopters whilst carrying half a ton more armour then the Durga. A Large Pulse Laser and 4 SRM-6's with 3 tons of ammo make up the Kali's weapons. A fearsome reputation in the Clan Homeworlds and in the Inner Sphere has ensured every Clan possess at least a handful of the heavy gunships. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. content.original: Entering service in 3049, the 40 ton Neith Scout Tank was developed to offer a heavier alternative to the lighter Asshur. Rushed into development as a crash program, the Neith is partially based on the SLDF Chevalier. Powered by a 300 rated cXL Engine, the Neith can reach speeds of 126kph giving it the speed to outrun most opponents. A cER Large Laser provides the vehicles long range punch, while a pair of Light Machine Guns provide close range firepower. The Neith’s main selling point is the combination of a TAG, Active Probe and an ECM Suite; this combined with the vehicles speed and Ferro-Fibrous armour make it a highly effective scout. Only deployed by Hell’s Horses, the Neith is fast becoming a mainstay of their combined arms units. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. content.original: Created to fill a noticeable gap in the Hell's Horses touman, the Nergal is a 100 ton heavy missile carrier developed for short range fire support missions. Powered by a 300 rated XL Engine that allows the tank to reach speeds of 50kph, the Nergal is armoured in 19.5 tons of Ferro Fibrous armour, making it extremely hard to kill. 6 LRM-15's make up the tanks main weapons, while 2 Small Pulse Lasers are mounted to deter infantry. An ECM suite and AMS help to shield the Nergal from counter battery fire. Mainly used by the Horses, the Nergal has also appeared in the Toumans of the Wolves, Scorpions and Blood Spirits. content.original: Created as a replacement to the Ares, the Nerio was designed to fulfil the demand for a tracked vehicle that boasted comparable performance to the Ares while possessing heavier armour. 4Built around a 240 rated XL Engine, the Nerio has a top speed of 97kph, a full 11kph higher then the Ares. Armour protection is boosted with the Nerio covered in 6 tons of Ferro Fibrous armour. The main weapon is a Large Pulse Laser, with an LRM-20 and SRM-6 providing backup within their respective ranges. Both missile launchers include the Artemis IV FCS. Primarily used by the Hell's Horses, the design has also spread to the Wolf, Coyote and Ghost Bear Clans. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Powered by a 250 rated XL Engine, the Nike has a 5 ton troop bay protected by 8.5 tons of Ferro Fibrous armour. Primarily used by the Hell's Horses, some can also be found in the touman of the Snow Ravens where they are fielded as traditional gun tanks. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: Inspired by reports of multi-gun tanks used by Inner Sphere forces, the Hell's Horses created the Tezcatlipoca as a replacement to the ageing Oro Heavy Tank. Powered by a 240 rated fuel cell, the Tezcatlipoca can reach speeds of 65kph and has 10.5 tons of armour. Armed with a pair of Large Chemical Lasers, the Tezcatlipoca is somewhat short ranged by Clan standards, but the reliability and low cost of manufacture more then make up for this. A quartet of Medium Chemical Lasers and 4 Machine Guns provide additional fire power at closer ranges. Currently only fielded by Hell's Horses, the bulk of these tanks have been allocated to second line units; often as command vehicles. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. content.original: Built as a lighter alternative to the SLDF Lightning, the 25 ton Vel Harasser is a fast cavalry tank. Built around a 95 rated cXL Engine, the Vel Harasser reaches speeds only slightly slower then those of the 35 ton Lightning. Armed with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers, a pair of SRM-6's and an ER Small Laser; the Vel Harasser trades some of the Lightnings speed for a heavier weapons loadout whilst still retaining the armour load of it's predecessor. Viewed as a waste of resources by most Clans, the Vel Harasser is only fielded by the Coyotes and Hell's Horses at present. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. content.original: Developed to replace the various heavy battle tanks in use by the Hell's Horses, the Yama is a 65 ton OmniTank. Powered by a 325 rated XL Engine, the Yama can reach speeds of 80kph while carrying 9.5 tons of armour, an Armoured Motive System to protect it's vulnerable tracks and a pair of forward mounted LMG's. Primarily used by the Hells Horses, though Clan Wolf is known to make use of the vehicle with several stars worth in their second line units. The standard load out is stripped out and replaced with a pair of ER Large Lasers supported by a Targeting Computer and an AMS; turning the Adder C into a dedicated sniper with a flater heat curve then the Adder Prime. An additional Flamer is added for close range defence alongside 3 more Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Developed by Clan Burrock to augment second line units, the Dervish IIC is a rebuild of a number of Star League Dervishes found in a Brian Cache. Eventually spreading to other Clans, the design would prove to be a dependable and tough Mech, with a production line opening in 3000 to meet the Burrocks needs. Armed with a pair of LRM-10's for ranged combat; and a mix of ER Lasers and SRM's for close combat, the 55 ton Dervish IIC is powered by a 275 rated Fusion Core. Favouring a mix of fire power and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox A-EWR is s an emergency refit developed by the Invading Clans to improve the Mechs combat effectiveness. The standard Gauss Rifle is swapped for an LB-10X with a pair of Flamers and a Small Pulse Laser added to handle enemy infantry. content.original: A second attempt at creating a totem Mech, the Taranis is the successor to the Thunder Stallion. Based on the same chassis as the Thunder Stallion, the Taranis is built around a 340 rated XL Engine, giving it a top speed of 60kph. Armour levels are virtually unchanged from the original Thunder Stallion and the Taranis retains the 2 Left Torso LRM racks and the Right Torso LB-20X AC. An ER PPC is added to the Center Torso and a Flamer is mounted in the Right Torso. The remaining weight is dedicated to upgrading the LRM-15's to use Artemis IV. Designed to run faster and with greater endurance then the original Mech, the Taranis does run somewhat hotter with it's new loadout, though the improved combat performance somewhat mitigates this. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21

content.original: Entering service in 3024, the 25 ton Durga was developed by the Hell's Horses as a heavier version of the Donar Assault Helicopter. Weighing 4 tons more then it's predecessor, the Durga is built around a 110 rated XL Engine, making it faster then the lighter Donar. Armed with an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-15, 2 Medium Pulse Lasers and a Small Pulse Laser, the Durga is built for long range engagements; whilst still possessing a potent short range punch. Defensively an ECM Suite and Ferro Fibrous armour protect the Durga. Manufactured by both the Hell's Horses and the Diamond Sharks, the Durga has spread throughout the Clans and most field at least 1 star of them. content.original: Designed to fill a need for a heavily armoured and armoured assault transport, the 100 ton Ganesha can carry several points of Elementals or other Battle Armour while shaking off all but the heaviest of hits. Powered by a 300 rated XL Engine, the Ganesha has 19.5 tons of Ferro Fibrous armour and can reach a top speed of 50kph. Armed with a Large Pulse Laser and 2 Streak SRM-6’s, the Ganesha mounts 2 Vehicle Flamers and an AMS on the tanks front. Another Vehicle Flamer and AMS cover the tanks rear. content.original: Entering service in 3049, the 40 ton Neith Scout Tank was developed to offer a heavier alternative to the lighter Asshur. Rushed into development as a crash program, the Neith is partially based on the SLDF Chevalier. Powered by a 300 rated cXL Engine, the Neith can reach speeds of 126kph giving it the speed to outrun most opponents. A cER Large Laser provides the vehicles long range punch, while a pair of Light Machine Guns provide close range firepower. The Neith’s main selling point is the combination of a TAG, Active Probe and an ECM Suite; this combined with the vehicles speed and Ferro-Fibrous armour make it a highly effective scout. Only deployed by Hell’s Horses, the Neith is fast becoming a mainstay of their combined arms units. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. content.original: Created to fill a noticeable gap in the Hell's Horses touman, the Nergal is a 100 ton heavy missile carrier developed for short range fire support missions. Powered by a 300 rated XL Engine that allows the tank to reach speeds of 50kph, the Nergal is armoured in 19.5 tons of Ferro Fibrous armour, making it extremely hard to kill. 6 LRM-15's make up the tanks main weapons, while 2 Small Pulse Lasers are mounted to deter infantry. An ECM suite and AMS help to shield the Nergal from counter battery fire. Mainly used by the Horses, the Nergal has also appeared in the Toumans of the Wolves, Scorpions and Blood Spirits. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: Created as a replacement to the Ares, the Nerio was designed to fulfil the demand for a tracked vehicle that boasted comparable performance to the Ares while possessing heavier armour. 4Built around a 240 rated XL Engine, the Nerio has a top speed of 97kph, a full 11kph higher then the Ares. Armour protection is boosted with the Nerio covered in 6 tons of Ferro Fibrous armour. The main weapon is a Large Pulse Laser, with an LRM-20 and SRM-6 providing backup within their respective ranges. Both missile launchers include the Artemis IV FCS. Primarily used by the Hell's Horses, the design has also spread to the Wolf, Coyote and Ghost Bear Clans. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. content.original: Conceived as a heavy APC, the Nike is a 50 ton vehicle that carries armour rivalling that of heavier tanks. Powered by a 250 rated XL Engine, the Nike has a 5 ton troop bay protected by 8.5 tons of Ferro Fibrous armour. An LRM-15 and LB-10X provide sufficient firepower to cripple or kill most threats while a pair of LMG's can provide the embarked Elementals with covering fire. Primarily used by the Hell's Horses, some can also be found in the touman of the Snow Ravens where they are fielded as traditional gun tanks. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. content.original: Inspired by reports of multi-gun tanks used by Inner Sphere forces, the Hell's Horses created the Tezcatlipoca as a replacement to the ageing Oro Heavy Tank. Powered by a 240 rated fuel cell, the Tezcatlipoca can reach speeds of 65kph and has 10.5 tons of armour. Armed with a pair of Large Chemical Lasers, the Tezcatlipoca is somewhat short ranged by Clan standards, but the reliability and low cost of manufacture more then make up for this. A quartet of Medium Chemical Lasers and 4 Machine Guns provide additional fire power at closer ranges. Currently only fielded by Hell's Horses, the bulk of these tanks have been allocated to second line units; often as command vehicles. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armed with a pair of LRM-10's for ranged combat; and a mix of ER Lasers and SRM's for close combat, the 55 ton Dervish IIC is powered by a 275 rated Fusion Core. content.original: A second attempt at creating a totem Mech, the Taranis is the successor to the Thunder Stallion. Based on the same chassis as the Thunder Stallion, the Taranis is built around a 340 rated XL Engine, giving it a top speed of 60kph. Armour levels are virtually unchanged from the original Thunder Stallion and the Taranis retains the 2 Left Torso LRM racks and the Right Torso LB-20X AC. An ER PPC is added to the Center Torso and a Flamer is mounted in the Right Torso. The remaining weight is dedicated to upgrading the LRM-15's to use Artemis IV. Designed to run faster and with greater endurance then the original Mech, the Taranis does run somewhat hotter with it's new loadout, though the improved combat performance somewhat mitigates this. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21

content.original: At face value, the MAL-Y-SH-LAZR is an extensive reworking of the MAL-YZ. Upon closer examination, however, it can be seen that RISC took the unprecedented step of expanding the Malice's chassis, up-massing it into the superheavy weight class. Initial reports by Spina Khanate from Sandhurst confirm that technicians from Skobel contributed their expertise to this effort. While this upsizing changed little of the Malice's overall performance—indeed, slowing it down a little bit - the roomier frame was necessary to accommodate its massive cooling apparatus. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.3 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Malice appears to be on its way towards becoming one of the premier mercenary assault 'Mechs of the age. Seen most often in the Galatean Defense Force and the Republic Armed Forces, the Malice has seen a lot of action for such a recent addition to the battlefield. Very fast for an assault 'Mech, topping out around 64 km/h, this brute can bring a withering barrage of autocannon fire to bear. Protected by more than nineteen tons of standard armor, the Malice can remain in combat for a long time.

content.original: Debuted in 3144 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Marie Costa, the most striking piece of technology this machine features is a Void Signature System followed by the Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous Armor that replaced its original Capellan-style Starshield Stealth Armor and its eleven Double Heat Sinks. In the weapons section, a single MML-9 launcher appears where once there were twin MML-3s, while the mech losses the Light PPCs in favor of more ER Medium Lasers (now three). Missing is Beagle active probe while an Improved Narc Missile Beacon Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

Its 425 rated extralight engine provides more repositiong capabilities than most 'Mechs around its size, but the design still struggles from the inherent inmaneuverability of the superheavy class of BattleMechs. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.5 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Despite the original being introduced in 2564 updated Condors are still in production as of the start of the 32nd Century. Substantial armor of at least six tons and various mid and long range weapon packages keep the Condor relevant. A heavy cavalry unit designed for rapid reaction to a shifting battle, the Condor was one of the few heavy hover tanks available at the time of it's introduction. This immense hovercraft is capable of a flank speed of 129 km/h and a cruising speed of 86 km/h, making it one of the fastest vehicles in its weight class. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: Tall, squat, and using four treads, the Demolisher has a well-earned reputation as one of the most deadly vehicles on the battlefield. Designed to counteract the increasing scarcity of 'Mechs during the Succession Wars, the Demolisher became popular, especially on worlds where BattleMechs were not available. The Demolisher is armed with two AC/20s, which are enough to make any other unit, 'Mechs included, pause. The relatively short range of the guns means that manoeuvrable units with long-range weaponry can confound the Demolisher. It utilizes 10 tons of armor for protection, and the I.C.E. motor allows for a cruising speed 32.4km/h. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. content.original: Designed in 2667, the Rhino was intended as a far more heavily armored version of the ubiquitous LRM Carrier. While carrying one less 20 tube launcher, the Rhino is covered in seventeen tons of armor, a whopping fifteen more than a Quik-based carrier can boast. Designed to anchor defensive lines, the Rhino mounts two LRM-20 launchers alongside a pair of Medium Lasers in its turret, supported by a single LRM-10 mounted forward. The vehicle's total of four tons of LRM reloads compare favourably with the standard carrier, while the lasers allow it some defensive ability while retreating to rearm; however, the vehicle's extremely slow speed greatly hampers any retreat once engaged in battle. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.content: Стелс-двигатель, разработанный инженерами племени Миннесоты, представляет собой необычный синтез проектных концепций: в нем свойства системы «Нулевой сигнатуры» по снижению заметности интегрированы непосредственно в ядро ​​двигателя. Несмотря на применение технологий, направленных на уменьшение массы, дополнительные теплоотводы, перегородки и каналы сводят на нет всю достигнутую экономию веса. Подобные двигатели зачастую предпочитают стандартным системам NSS, поскольку они способны отводить излишки тепла даже в неактивном состоянии.

content.original: Despite the original being introduced in 2564 updated Condors are still in production as of the start of the 32nd Century. Substantial armor of at least six tons and various mid and long range weapon packages keep the Condor relevant. A heavy cavalry unit designed for rapid reaction to a shifting battle, the Condor was one of the few heavy hover tanks available at the time of it's introduction. This immense hovercraft is capable of a flank speed of 129 km/h and a cruising speed of 86 km/h, making it one of the fastest vehicles in its weight class. Biome Restrictions: None. Солидная броня весом не менее шести тонн и различные комплексы вооружения средней и большой дальности делают Condor по-прежнему актуальным. «Кондор» — тяжелый кавалерийский юнит, предназначенный для быстрого реагирования на изменения в ходе боя, был одним из немногих тяжелых ховер-танков, доступных на момент его появления. Этот огромный танк способен развивать скорость до 129 км/ч и крейсерскую скорость 86 км/ч, что делает его одним из самых быстрых транспортных средств в своей весовой категории. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 8/12 гексов / 240/360 метров. content.original: Tall, squat, and using four treads, the Demolisher has a well-earned reputation as one of the most deadly vehicles on the battlefield. Designed to counteract the increasing scarcity of 'Mechs during the Succession Wars, the Demolisher became popular, especially on worlds where BattleMechs were not available. The Demolisher is armed with two AC/20s, which are enough to make any other unit, 'Mechs included, pause. The relatively short range of the guns means that manoeuvrable units with long-range weaponry can confound the Demolisher. It utilizes 10 tons of armor for protection, and the I.C.E. motor allows for a cruising speed 32.4km/h. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. content.original: Designed in 2667, the Rhino was intended as a far more heavily armored version of the ubiquitous LRM Carrier. While carrying one less 20 tube launcher, the Rhino is covered in seventeen tons of armor, a whopping fifteen more than a Quik-based carrier can boast. Designed to anchor defensive lines, the Rhino mounts two LRM-20 launchers alongside a pair of Medium Lasers in its turret, supported by a single LRM-10 mounted forward. content.original: At 255 tons, the Armageddon Prototype is less a BattleMech and more a mobile doomsday device. Built by the Minnesota Tribe, its centerpiece is the Rotary Railgun. A four-shot magnetic cannon so extreme it risks structural failure with each volley. Flanking it are eight compact PPCs, equipped with particle recyclers for increased efficiency, a Fire and Forget 8 for indirect fire and an I-AC/20 linked to an Ares TPS fire-control unit for medium-range precision. But the price for this arsenal is speed. The Armageddon is slow, ponderous, and vulnerable if outmaneuvered. Still, when it arrives on the field, it obliterates any enemy. content.original: The rotary railgun is an absurd concept realized through sheer mass and stubbornness. Designed for the towering Armageddon superheavy, it fires iridium-cored slugs at extreme velocities using magnetically accelerated rails. Capable of firing up to four rounds in rapid succession, each additional shot exponentially increases the stress on the weapon's internals. By the third discharge, hairline fractures are common along the reinforced barrel assembly, and the rotary loading system risks catastrophic misalignment. After such volleys, the gun must be manually reconditioned before it can fire again. Cycling multi-ton slugs through a rotary rail housing defies practicality. The breech is composed of exotic zero-G forged compressed hexalloy-lattice composites, anything less would shatter under the strain. Even then, the sheer kinetic force threatens to shear components loose.

content.original: The Grond is a massive 175-ton OmniMech built by Hallowed Iron Assembly for the Minnesota Tribe, visually resembling a larger Stone Rhino. Equipped with an Endo-Steel frame, a potent 350-rating XL engine, and Plasmo-Electric Heat Sinks, it expertly manages heat from its devastating energy weapons. Designed foremost as an offensive alpha-striker, the Grond unleashes overwhelming, high-impact volleys to shatter enemy defenses quickly. Its imposing presence and raw power embody the Tribe’s doctrine of relentless, decisive firepower, making it a terrifying force that dominates the battlefield with swift, crushing strikes.

Equipped with an Endo-Steel frame, a potent 350-rating XL engine, and Plasmo-Electric Heat Sinks, it expertly manages heat from its devastating energy weapons. Designed foremost as an offensive alpha-striker, the Grond unleashes overwhelming, high-impact volleys to shatter enemy defenses quickly. Its imposing presence and raw power embody the Tribe’s doctrine of relentless, decisive firepower, making it a terrifying force that dominates the battlefield with swift, crushing strikes.

Four Improved Gauss Rifles provide sustained ballistic damage, while two i-AC/10s with Ares TPS Attachments deliver rapid, pinpoint bursts aided by advanced predictive targeting. Complementing these are four Early Clan Extended-Range Medium Lasers, optimized for reliable performance at medium range. The integrated PHI Suite enhances coordinated sensor targeting. Designed for flexible frontline roles, the C loadout balances ranged ballistic fire with energy support, leveraging superior targeting systems to maximize hit probability despite the Grond’s typical heat management challenges common to Minnesota Tribe superheavies. content.original: The Hierophant is a 200-ton superheavy OmniMech fielded by the Minnesota Tribe as a battlefield oracle, commanding, interpreting, and unleashing battlefield truth with devastating clarity. Named for the ancient spiritual title of one who reveals sacred mysteries, the Hierophant embodies the Tribe’s view of war as a ritual of revelation. Exclusively piloted by high-ranking commanders, it serves as both a strategic nerve center and an unyielding war idol. Powered by a volatile Magnothermic Plasma Engine and cooled with advanced Plasmo-Electric Heat Sinks, the Hierophant stands as a towering symbol of the Tribe’s grim, transcendent purpose.

content.original: As the original loadout of the Hierophant, the Prime configuration was initially a test platform for TEMPEST and Ares attachments. It features 2 Hyper PPCs with TEMPEST, 2 i-AC/10s with Ares TPS, and a flamer equipped with TEMPEST, though the flamer’s extremely short range rendered it practically useless in combat, serving only to verify TEMPEST compatibility. The inclusion of AMS Mk2 rounds out the build. Its strong performance led to expanded Hierophant production and inspired the diverse loadouts that followed, cementing its role as the Minnesota Tribe’s premier superheavy command ‘Mech. Exclusively piloted by high-ranking commanders, it serves as both a strategic nerve center and an unyielding war idol. Powered by a volatile Magnothermic Plasma Engine and cooled with advanced Plasmo-Electric Heat Sinks, the Hierophant stands as a towering symbol of the Tribe’s grim, transcendent purpose.

content.original: The Hiisi is a formidable 150-ton BattleMech crafted by Red Root Foundry, designed to dominate the battlefield as an intimidating zone controller. With its broad silhouette and imposing stance, the Hiisi excels at area denial and battlefield control, using heavy weapons and layered defenses to hold key positions. Its rugged construction reflects Minnesota Tribe resilience, blending advanced armor and powerful weaponry. Known for its psychological impact as much as its firepower, the Hiisi commands respect and fear, making it a preferred choice for spearheading assaults or anchoring defensive lines. Its name echoes ancient Finnish myths, symbolizing relentless strength and primal ferocity.

content.original: The 125-ton Hyaenodont OmniMech is a long-range support platform fielded by the Minnesota Tribe and constructed by Twin Forge Assemblies. Built on an Endo-Steel frame and powered by a 355-rated XL engine, it specializes in providing withering fire support from a distance, often anchoring the rear line of superheavy formations. It is clad in Ferro-Silk armor, a fragile yet lightweight steel-polymer lattice developed by Northern Meshworks, allowing for greater weapon mass at the expense of durability, consistent with the Tribe’s doctrine of prioritizing firepower above protection. Its name comes from an ancient Terran apex predator known for its bone-crushing bite and grim persistence, an icon preserved in Clan Wolverine mythos. Revived as a 'Mech by the Tribe, the Hyaenodont reflects their philosophy of overwhelming force and relentless pressure, hammering enemies down until there’s nothing left to resist.

This build excels at long-range bombardment and precise fire support, though it is less effective in close combat due to its focus on ranged weaponry. content.original: The 125-ton Hyaenodont OmniMech is a long-range support platform fielded by the Minnesota Tribe and constructed by Twin Forge Assemblies. Built on an Endo-Steel frame and powered by a 355-rated XL engine, it specializes in providing withering fire support from a distance, often anchoring the rear line of superheavy formations. It is clad in Ferro-Silk armor, a fragile yet lightweight steel-polymer lattice developed by Northern Meshworks, allowing for greater weapon mass at the expense of durability, consistent with the Tribe’s doctrine of prioritizing firepower above protection. Its name comes from an ancient Terran apex predator known for its bone-crushing bite and grim persistence, an icon preserved in Clan Wolverine mythos. Revived as a 'Mech by the Tribe, the Hyaenodont reflects their philosophy of overwhelming force and relentless pressure, hammering enemies down until there’s nothing left to resist.

content.original: The Smilodon is a 110-ton line BattleMech fielded by the Minnesota Tribe, produced by Independence Weaponry as a dependable frontline brawler. Named after the prehistoric saber-toothed predator, the Smilodon symbolizes brutal efficiency and predatory focus, traits the Tribe values in its martial tradition. Its design draws inspiration from the Ebon Jaguar, sharing a low-slung, forward-thrusting posture and a menacing profile suited for battlefield intimidation. While lacking the advanced modularity of an OmniMech, the Smilodon is built for sustained frontline engagement. It uses Ferro-Silk armor, a lightweight, steel-polymer lattice developed by Northern Meshworks, trading some durability for weight savings to support heavier weapons in line with the Tribe’s focus on overwhelming offensive capability. The Smilodon stands as a testament to the Tribe’s doctrine of overwhelming force and their refusal to abandon classic battle-tested principles.

A Guardian ECM bolsters electronic protection, and the PHI Suite enables lance-wide targeting synchronization. This variant emphasizes saturation and mixed-range suppression, excelling in chaotic close-range skirmishes where layered firepower can overwhelm defenders. content.original: The Smilodon X is an unconventional close-quarters variant, likely intended for garrison or defensive operations where engagement ranges are minimal. It mounts four Flamers with TEMPEST plasma manifolds, used more for deterrence and thermal saturation than raw damage, complemented by four Early Clan ER Small Lasers, a Machine Gun Array, and a single Improved AC/20 loaded with HEAR ammunition for devastating point-blank strikes. Two Improved SRM-6 launchers provide short-range missile support, while an AMS system enhances defense against incoming fire.Despite its brutal short-range payload, the Smilodon X's effectiveness is highly situational. It uses a Magnothermic Plasma Engine to fuel its thermal systems and is equipped with a PHI Suite for lance-wide target sharing, a Guardian ECM for electronic protection, and an Active Probe for battlefield reconnaissance and ambush detection. Its design draws inspiration from the Ebon Jaguar, sharing a low-slung, forward-thrusting posture and a menacing profile suited for battlefield intimidation. While lacking the advanced modularity of an OmniMech, the Smilodon is built for sustained frontline engagement. It uses Ferro-Silk armor, a lightweight, steel-polymer lattice developed by Northern Meshworks, trading some durability for weight savings to support heavier weapons in line with the Tribe’s focus on overwhelming offensive capability. The Smilodon stands as a testament to the Tribe’s doctrine of overwhelming force and their refusal to abandon classic battle-tested principles.

content.original: Magnothermic Plasma Engine
content.prevOriginal: Magnothermic Plasma Engine
content.content: Magnothermic Plasma Engine

content.original:
The Magnothermic Plasma Engine is a fearsome evolution of the Vectored Plasma Engine, reserved for the Minnesota Tribe’s superheavy 'Mechs, where brute force outweighs finesse. Through thermoplasma vectoring, the engine’s cooling cycle superheats and ionizes working fluids, which are then precisely manipulated by electromagnetic fields. These fields channel the plasma via reinforced conduits into weapon manifolds known as Thermo-Electro-Magnetic Plasma Energy Synchronization Transducers (TEMPEST). TEMPEST units amplify thermal flow into PPC, flamer, plasma, and TSEMP systems,dramatically increasing destructive output while also reducing internal heat buildup, as the ionized plasma acts as an auxiliary coolant fluid that enhances connection to the core’s immense heat dissipation systems.

This pursuit of raw firepower comes at a cost. Jump jets are unusable, as their operation destabilizes the engine’s delicate thermo-electromagnetic flow balance. Additionally, the intense electromagnetic activity dramatically increases the ‘Mech’s visibility to enemy sensors. While the engine is lighter than conventional fusion cores in its class due to structural optimizations, its volatile nature makes it a walking powder keg; damage to plasma conduits can trigger catastrophic detonations. Despite the risks, Tribe MechWarriors embrace its brutal potential with unwavering conviction.

content.original: These reinforced transfer lines are engineered to channel superheated, magnetically-contained plasma from fusion cores to TEMPEST-equipped weapon systems. Constructed from layered ferro-ceramic alloys and laced with electromagnetic stabilizers, Magnothermic Plasma Conduits maintain plasma coherence under immense pressure and heat. Any rupture can trigger violent chain reactions, making them both vital and dangerously volatile components of superheavy-grade plasma amplification systems.

content.original: The B loadout turns the Grond into a powerful long-range striker, armed with a Railgun, two Improved Gauss Rifles, a Siege Laser, and a Heavy Siege Laser. This setup delivers devastating alpha strikes capable of breaching heavy armor and softening enemy lines at range. Equipped with Beagle Probe and PHI Suite for enhanced targeting, the B configuration excels in precision engagements and ranged offense. While its immense firepower generates significant heat, a common trait among Minnesota Tribe superheavies, the B loadout’s overwhelming damage often forces enemies to break or retreat before heat becomes a critical issue.
