It features 2 Hyper PPCs with TEMPEST, 2 i-AC/10s with Ares TPS, and a flamer equipped with TEMPEST, though the flamer’s extremely short range rendered it practically useless in combat, serving only to verify TEMPEST compatibility. The inclusion of AMS Mk2 rounds out the build. Its strong performance led to expanded Hierophant production and inspired the diverse loadouts that followed, cementing its role as the Minnesota Tribe’s premier superheavy command ‘Mech. Equipped with an Endo-Steel frame, a potent 350-rating XL engine, and Plasmo-Electric Heat Sinks, it expertly manages heat from its devastating energy weapons. Its imposing presence and raw power embody the Tribe’s doctrine of relentless, decisive firepower, making it a terrifying force that dominates the battlefield with swift, crushing strikes.

Named for the ancient spiritual title of one who reveals sacred mysteries, the Hierophant embodies the Tribe’s view of war as a ritual of revelation. content.original: The Hiisi is a formidable 150-ton BattleMech crafted by Red Root Foundry, designed to dominate the battlefield as an intimidating zone controller. With its broad silhouette and imposing stance, the Hiisi excels at area denial and battlefield control, using heavy weapons and layered defenses to hold key positions. Its rugged construction reflects Minnesota Tribe resilience, blending advanced armor and powerful weaponry. Known for its psychological impact as much as its firepower, the Hiisi commands respect and fear, making it a preferred choice for spearheading assaults or anchoring defensive lines. Its name echoes ancient Finnish myths, symbolizing relentless strength and primal ferocity.

content.original: The Hyaenodont J is a rare superheavy design equipped with two Booster Jets, rocket-assisted propulsion units powered by dedicated fusion cores, providing limited vertical lift and forward thrust capabilities uncommon among superheavies. These boosters partially offset the short maximum effective range of its two Rotary AP Large Bore Gauss Rifles, enabling improved maneuverability for close-range engagements. However, in large open areas, the mech’s high sensor signature makes it easily detected and avoided, limiting its ability to close with targets despite booster assistance. The loadout also includes two Enhanced Extended-Range Particle Projector Cannons with Particle Recycler Modules for sustained energy output. Target data sharing within the lance is managed via an integrated PHI Suite. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long + Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.28 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The 125-ton Hyaenodont OmniMech is a long-range support platform fielded by the Minnesota Tribe and constructed by Twin Forge Assemblies. Built on an Endo-Steel frame and powered by a 355-rated XL engine, it specializes in providing withering fire support from a distance, often anchoring the rear line of superheavy formations. It is clad in Ferro-Silk armor, a fragile yet lightweight steel-polymer lattice developed by Northern Meshworks, allowing for greater weapon mass at the expense of durability, consistent with the Tribe’s doctrine of prioritizing firepower above protection. Its name comes from an ancient Terran apex predator known for its bone-crushing bite and grim persistence, an icon preserved in Clan Wolverine mythos. Revived as a 'Mech by the Tribe, the Hyaenodont reflects their philosophy of overwhelming force and relentless pressure, hammering enemies down until there’s nothing left to resist.

content.original: The F loadout combines rapid-fire and energy weaponry for versatile offensive roles. Twin Rotary Gauss Rifles, prototypes from Clan Wolverine’s Project Omega, deliver high heat and burst damage, with a risky “Overload” mode for powerful single shots. Complementing these are two Ion Stream Projectors that scatter energized plasma particles for close-range suppression, backed by two i-LRM 15 launchers for indirect guided missile fire. A Medium Pulse Laser in the head provides additional short-range precision. Equipped with Beagle Probe, Guardian ECM, and the PHI Suite, this setup excels in flexible engagement but demands careful heat and ammo management. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.4 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: When the RISC laboratories developed the superheavy version of the Wraith Suppression Shield System, they wanted to see how it fared in actual combat at a larger scale before they re-geared to their own heavily over-utilized superheavy factories. Three of the Great Houses were persuaded to design a number of superheavy 'Mechs around the system, all three ending up with very similar looks due to the prototype stealth system requirements and pre-designed components supplied by the Republic. content.original: The Menace is one of the heavier Clan Superheavy OmniMechs, weighing in at 185 tons. Based on an Endo Steel chassis with a 350 XL engine, the chassis is not particularly fast or agile, but it makes up for it with its general offensive package. All configurations of the Menace are heavily focused on offensive firepower at range, often used as a long range option when firepower matters more than survival. To ensure it has enough cooling it uses the volataile Prototype heat sinks, meaning any internal critical hits can turn deadly, but an acceptable risk considering its large offensive arsenal.

content.original: The Menace is one of the heavier Clan Superheavy OmniMechs, weighing in at 185 tons. Based on an Endo Steel chassis with a 350 XL engine, the chassis is not particularly fast or agile, but it makes up for it with its general offensive package. All configurations of the Menace are heavily focused on offensive firepower at range, often used as a long range option when firepower matters more than survival. To ensure it has enough cooling it uses the volataile Prototype heat sinks, meaning any internal critical hits can turn deadly, but an acceptable risk considering its large offensive arsenal.

content.original: The Roughneck, hailing from humble beginnings as the Loader King, this Industrial mech turned Militarised workhorse has seen many a role. This specific model has come about after a former 'Notable' Solaris Arena gladiator fell on hard times. Trying to make ends meat they agreed to a sponsorship for Quicsells latest edition of their new and improved 'Quicsell Bargain battle Royale' . Packing some of the noteworthy Arena dominating Quicsell technologies does this specific version come with patented armor, a flexible TSM system and enough firepower to last a good battle. A roaring Quicsell Ultra AC 20 leads the charge backed up by their patented 'Streak' SRM launchers for accurate and conservative ammo usage. As customed to Roughneck loadouts it also brings two handheld disposable One Shot cannons for a finishing blow, then to be discarded. A small REX laser in the cockpit rounds out the armory in case of it's rather sparse ammo running out. But if the opposition isn't down by that point, it's on you soldier. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

content.original: I feel pity for the poor soul that had to turn a perfectly fine machine into this excuse for a working Battlemech. Sure it's not as faultily wired or skimps on the armor as much as some of their other gimmick models. Yes there is some severe firepower here but the drawbacks, the ammo consumption is horrible on these supposed 'Premium' launchers. And the cooling, this is meant for the Arena? How badly do you want the Pilot to sweat while risking their paycheck. All considered, could have been worse but I am not betting my personal stash of Scotch on this bucket of bolts anytime soon.

content.original: Quicsell Berserker Mobile Artillery Platform™Here at Quicsell, we understand that your weapons of war need to last. That's why we're proud to introduce our latest innovation in artillery support platform capability: The Berserker Mobile Artillery Platform™!A towering installation of long-range firepower, the Berserker combines cutting-edge targeting sensors with Quicsell's famous discounted premium shelling! Whether you require a generous missile, a quality artillery shell to rout pesky infantry formations, or simply a good old-fashioned pelting, the Berserker has the firepower you need.Do they have a gun? Show them a bigger gun!Featuring the magnificent One Shot Longtom Cannon™, equipped with an extended barrel specifically engineered to really drive the point home. Literally. From a very, very long way away. In fact, Quicsell recommends remaining at a considerable distance from anything you intend to shoot.Inspire fear. Inspire awe. Inspire the enemy to reconsider their life choices. Put the Berserker to work on the battlefield today!Quicsell advises against firing all weaponry simultaneously, as doing so may void any applicable warranty on the purchase. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
